name: Joe Kent
subject: Join President Trump and me tomorrow night!
body:
Dear Supporter,
Tomorrow, Monday night, I invite you to join President Trump and me for a telephone rally at 8 PM Eastern, 5 PM Pacific. Dial in at 360-972-3918. I've attached a graphic that you can share on social media to encourage others to attend as well.
I'm honored to be endorsed by President Trump. That's one of the reasons I'm facing an onslaught of attacks from dark money groups - over $2 million has been spent against me in the final weeks.
The last thing the DC establishment wants is to replace their favorite RINO, Jaime Herrera Beutler, with an America First fighter who will oppose amnesty, open borders, vaccine mandates, and foreign military adventures that cost us precious American lives.
Please help me overcome them with a contribution today at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/cGeXDDwzqp7PeqkiD5GsqA/HWbxRXucCN73QulIRfat8Q).
We need this funding to pay for texting and digital ads to reach the still-undecided voters. Anything helps.
Respectfully,
Joe Kent
PS - Dial into the telerally with me and President Trump on Monday night at 8 Eastern / 5 Pacific at 360.972.3918 and please make a donation to help us get across the finish line at [https://JoeKentforCongress.com/donate](https://contact.joekentforcongress.com/l/yKnBAvy7a4tJj7XnOa763cIw/cGeXDDwzqp7PeqkiD5GsqA/HWbxRXucCN73QulIRfat8Q).

| | | Friends,

9 days from this moment, we will be gathering for the Victory Watch Party for **[Alex.Vote.](https://alexbryantforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fc1855798e115b75c39c0a52&id=8f4a99b08a&e=3ccc624a45)**

You have a voice. You get a say. Your words have power.

Sometimes we forget just how much weight and influence we actually have.

That's what makes America great. We each have an opportunity to participate.

Sure, cultural-elites can cancel us, the media can ignore us, politicians can call us names, but no one can take away our voice - our right to vote.

For far too long we've allowed ourselves to be shamed into silence. They tell us our values are out of date, our opinions don't count, that we should stay home and be quiet.

They want us to get discouraged and remain subdued. That's what they are counting on, for all of us to give up.

But you're not going to do that... and neither am I. That's why in these final days up to the primary, I need you to spread the word with your friends and DONATE.

We just made a massive media buy for the last 9 days up to August 2nd. We spent wisely, however, we virtually drained the account. I need you to give today. $5, $25, $100, $500 or more.

[DONATE NOW](https://alexbryantforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fc1855798e115b75c39c0a52&id=ebe1d6907f&e=3ccc624a45)

Now here's the deal. I'm running for Congress because I'm a voice they can't silence. I'm not going to give up or shut up. I'm going to use the voice God gave me to stand up for truth.

As hard as they may try, they can't silence you either. You get to vote.

I believe we're about to send a loud and clear message to Washington. This is our government--Of the People, By the People, For the People. And we expect it to reflect our values.

That's why I'm asking you to show up on August 2nd and use YOUR voice.

And I see every gift that comes through. I'm looking for your gift tonight or tomorrow and thank you in advance for giving it!

In high school, I was my school’s valedictorian — and in Georgia, that meant being invited to a reception at the Governor’s Mansion.
My family didn’t have a car, so that morning, my parents and I took the bus from DeKalb to Buckhead. We arrived at the Governor’s mansion and walked up the side of the driveway, next to the cars carrying valedictorians from across the state.
But when we reached the guard gate, a guard stepped out, looked at us and said, “You don’t belong here. This is a private event.”
He took one look at us walking up from the bus and assumed I couldn’t possibly be one of the valedictorians. My parents set him straight and we were eventually allowed in. But I don’t remember meeting the governor that day. What I remember is a man standing in front of the most powerful place in Georgia, telling me I didn’t belong.
**[Now, I’m running for Governor to represent all Georgians from that same powerful place. Will you split a donation between Nan Whaley and I to join our movement for One Georgia?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48263630/357582499/-2095446912?refcode=nw_em_220724_1_t2&amount=5&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=&firstname=&lastname=&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=&employer=&occupation=&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS84ODM5MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjMjg5OGY5Yy1hZTBiLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=NSVyjSFgY_5v_B_oxscNWAPDZ_JigxFJVwq7-ey7QOs=)**
For far too long, too many Georgians have felt like they don't belong. They feel unseen, unheard and left behind because of their zip code or background. Together, we can make sure every Georgian, no matter who they are or where they live, has the opportunity to thrive.
But first, we face a hard fight in this campaign. We know that our opponent will be well-funded and that this race won’t be easy.

Stacey

---
| |

| |

| | Many of you have seen the beautiful pictures from the Webb telescope that came out this recently. I am so proud to be part of the industry that made this possible. The Webb telescope uses infrared technology to probe deep into space to see the origins of our universe. While we can’t see the “Big Bang” itself, we can see things that happened relatively shortly after. By delving into the past, we can understand how the universe works and how it affects us. Besides providing us with breathtaking, poetic, photographs of our universe, it provides us with information vital to our future within this universe. Space programs are expensive, but especially here in Maryland, where much of the space industry and NASA are located, the number of jobs created, and boost to our economy, make that expense very worthwhile. Further, the inventions that have come out of NASA, specifically for the space industry, have resulted in thousands of things that have benefited mankind on a daily basis. These include: firefighting equipment, artificial limbs, solar panels, dust buster vacuums, CAT Scans, water filtration devices, laser eye surgery, and even white composite fillings for teeth, just to name a few. We are happy to share some of the amazing images from the Webb telescope below. As your Congressman I, Gregory Coll, will make sure our national space programs stay strong for the Maryland economy, for the benefit of all peoples’ well-being, and for the future of our planet. Best always,Greg “Rocket” CollSend a “Rocket” to Congress Thank you for your continued support and please think about making a donation or volunteering to help. 15, Peter. That’s
how many weeks are left until the election. That means we only have:

15 more weeks to train volunteers and organizers so we can spread our
campaign’s bold, progressive message to every corner of Kentucky.

15 more weeks to run digital and TV ads so we can share Charles’ story and
explain to voters why he’s personally invested in passing policies that
center everyday people in our politics.

15 more weeks to make sure we do everything in our power to elect Charles
and expand our Senate majority so we can finally abolish the filibuster
and end the gridlock that’s preventing Congress from passing the urgent
change we need.

That’s not a whole lot of time,
Peter. That’s why we’re reaching
out to ask you for a big favor. Our campaign is relying on sustained
support these next 15 weeks to make sure we have the grassroots power to
scale our organizing work and take this campaign to the next level.

Bianca

| | As many of you know, STEM stands for education in “science, technology, engineering, and mathematics.” A lot of focus has been made to get girls and minorities into STEM. This is absolutely essential, though it’s necessary for all students. We need to make sure that all children are prepared to succeed, for their future, and that of America’s. To do this we need to implement science at a very young age. As you can see in the photos, I, Gregory Coll, believe in doing this with my own children. This is evidenced by these pictures: one at the Air and Space Museum and the other with the James Webb Space Telescope while it was at Goddard Space Flight Center here in Maryland. Not all children have the resources of a rocket scientist as a father, though sending me to Congress will put a solid supporter for all children to have the same opportunities my own children do in STEM. STEM can and should be implemented as early as posable including in preschool. Children who are exposed to math and science early are not afraid of them later in life. Whether you are a rocket scientist, just like me, or the manager of a theater or a restaurant, understanding math and understanding the scientific principles that keep food safe or help businesses keep up with technology is also part of why STEM is important. I, Gregory Coll, want an America where every child can understand technology and where America is the leader in technology around the world. I, Gregory Coll, want a Maryland where we retain great public schools and give parents choices when those schools aren’t as great as they should be. I, Gregory Coll, pledge to make sure every child is ready for the future, for a prosperous and safe future for them and for us all. Best always,Greg “Rocket” CollSend a “Rocket” to Congress Thank you for your continued support and please think about making a donation or volunteering to help. body:
Democrats in Pennsylvania must act!
| | | Team, it’s Kati from the DSCC.

Exactly one month later, it's still sinking in for many of us that the Supreme Court has overturned _Roe v. Wade_. While we knew this decision was more than likely coming, it doesn’t make me any less appalled, devastated and to be frank -- absolutely enraged. And in fact, now that this is _real_ , I feel all of these things now more than ever. But I know I am not alone.

So we cannot stay silent, especially in this moment when this cuts so deep for so many and we’re just plain tired. We must continue to go to the mat to uphold a woman’s right to make her own health care decisions, because we know damn well extremist Republicans are not going to stop here. Mitch McConnell has already said a national abortion ban is “possible” if he takes back our Senate majority.

name: Team Diehl-Allen
subject: Diehl/Allen Volunteer Help this Week
body:
Get Involved Today!
| | | |
---
| All, We are looking for volunteers to help us with the following. We have 5 weeks until the GOP primary election, so now is the time to get involved!
SECURITY: We are looking for volunteers willing to serve as security for Geoff and Leah at events. If this is something which interests you, please contact our security coordinator, Jim McGinn: jim.c.mcginn@gmail.com.
SIGN STANDOUTS: We would like to have a series of sign standouts for visibility across the state. Especially on weekends, when voters are traveling to weekend trips, these visibility events can really promote our candidates. We need individuals willing to step up in their area(promote to others, gather the signs and hand them out, etc.).
If you are willing to lead a sign standout in your community, please contact Annette Benenato at annette@geoffdiehl.com. We will provide you the signs/banners, and help to promote your location.
BALLOT REFERENDUM ON DRIVERS' LICENSES FOR ILLEGAL IMMIGRANTS: The push to get this question on the ballot continues. We need everyone's help! We have 4 more weeks to get the requisite number of signatures. If you support overturning this law, please lend some time. We are looking for individuals to lead ballot collection at their local grocery stores, community events, and at dumps on the weekends. Please let Annette know if you will help to organize a collection effort this week, either weeknights or this weekend, in your area.
GET OUT THE VOTE CALLS FOR GEOFF AND LEAH:
We are asking for individuals to make calls to get out the vote for the GOP primary for Geoff and Leah. If you can assist with this, please contact Deputy Field Director Bridget Hardiman, at bridget@geoffdiehl.com.
VOLUNTEER AT OUR HEADQUARTERS: The hours of operation at our Waltham and Plymouth Headquarters are listed on the www.geoffdiehl.com website/contact. Volunteers are needed to go there and pass out signs, push cards, bumper stickers, and make Get Out the Vote phone calls.
WEEKLY VOLUNTEER CALL:
Each Wednesday morning at 7:30 a.m., we have a volunteer zoom call. It's a great chance to ask questions and get inspired by the activism of others. Please join in this Wednesday, July 27th at 7:30 a.m.

name: Vikram for NH
subject: PRESS RELEASE: Vikram For N.H. Signs 11th Commandment Pledge
body:
---
| | | | | |
---
| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE July 25, 2022
---
| Contact: Todd Cheewing todd@vikram4nh.com; 516-521-7926
---
|
> PRESS RELEASE
Vikram Mansharamani Releases 11th Commandment Pledge; Encourages Opponents to Sign

---
---
CONCORD, NH - July 25, 2022 - Today, entrepreneur and GOP U.S. Senate candidate Vikram Mansharamani announced and signed a clean elections pledge and challenged his opponents to do the same. The pledge is based on Ronald Reagan's 11th Commandment: thou shalt not speak ill of a fellow Republican.
"This campaign is getting increasingly negative and I think Republicans need to stop slinging mud at each other and instead focus on beating the Democrats in the fall," said Mansharamani. "Today I am signing the Ronald Reagan 11th Commandment Pledge. I am going to talk about myself and the need to bring my business experience to Washington, DC. I am going to focus on the issues and I challenge the other candidates to do the same."
Mansharamani went on to say that while he is committed to running a positive campaign, he will not allow the other candidates to attack him without a response. The 11th Commandment pledge also includes a Vikram Amendment that allows for candidates to defend themselves.
"While I am committed to running a positive campaign, some of the other candidates have already shown their willingness to sling mud. I am nobody's punching bag, and if I am attacked, I will fight back," Mansharamani said.
The pledge comes after the increasingly negative tone of the campaign burst out into the open. Chuck Morse's campaign was recently accused of spreading negative information about Kevin Smith's tenure as Londonderry town manager.
"I believe wholeheartedly that sticking to the issues is the best way to respect the voters of New Hampshire," Mansharamani added. "Attacks are nothing but distractions from the runaway inflation and unnecessary energy dependence on foreign countries. The career politicians and bureaucrats have broken the economy and it is going to take a businessman to fix it."
The text of the pledge follows:
RONALD REAGAN'S 11TH COMMANDMENT CAMPAIGN PLEDGE
I will not attack a fellow Republican
Vikram Amendment
...unless they attack me first
---

"Today I am signing the Ronald Reagan 11th Commandment Pledge. I am going to talk about myself and the need to bring my business experience to Washington, DC. I am going to focus on the issues and I challenge the other candidates to do the same." Mansharamani went on to say that while he is committed to running a positive campaign, he will not allow the other candidates to attack him without a response. The 11th Commandment pledge also includes a Vikram Amendment that allows for candidates to defend themselves. "While I am committed to running a positive campaign, some of the other candidates have already shown their willingness to sling mud. I am nobody's punching bag, and if I am attacked, I will fight back," Mansharamani said. The pledge comes after the increasingly negative tone of the campaign burst out into the open. Chuck Morse's campaign was recently accused of spreading negative information about Kevin Smith's tenure as Londonderry town manager. "I believe wholeheartedly that sticking to the issues is the best way to respect the voters of New Hampshire," Mansharamani added. "Attacks are nothing but distractions from the runaway inflation and unnecessary energy dependence on foreign countries. The career politicians and bureaucrats have broken the economy and it is going to take a businessman to fix it." When a child has a parent in prison, they can experience so many overwhelming emotions. Many feel: Scared. Abandoned. Unloved. Forgotten. You can see why children of prisoners are among the most vulnerable kids in America. That's why I’m emailing you today—to ask for your help in bringing **hope and transformation** into the life of a boy or girl who has a parent in prison. Many children hide their deep hurt and bury their feelings. They need to experience unconditional love and believe they are worthy. They need you and me to remind them of God’s amazing love. Through Prison Fellowship Angel Tree, you can help make that possible by sending a boy or girl to an Angel Tree camp. Or by reaching a child with a Christmas gift, a note from their incarcerated parent, and the Gospel during the holiday season. Your generosity will bring joy to the world of an Angel Tree child throughout the year. Together, we can show these kids the love of Jesus and help them know they are valued—unlocking their potential for a brighter future!

Peter - I hate that I have to do this but the Democrats have left me no other choice.

The Democrats are POURING money into Wisconsin at an insane rate. Since I announced in January, liberal groups have poured at least $10.5M into Wisconsin to kick me out of the Senate. Between the 11 Democrats that are running against me, they've raised $17.6M.
**THINGS.
DO.
NOT.
LOOK.
GOOD. **
I am running up against my first extended deadline of Quarter 2 and I am incredibly concerned about what happens if I don't meet my goals this time around. Wisconsin is going to be one of the TOP battleground states this cycle, **_CNN_** has even rated me the MOST vulnerable Republican running for re-election.

Here is what this means for you if we don't win this one:
1. Two MORE years of a **BLUE** majority in the Senate
2. More **RADICAL WOKE** policies to interfere with your life as an American
3. A perilous future for our children and grandchildren.

When I first ran for the Senate, I ran because I was a concerned father who did not want my children's future mortgaged on woke liberal policies. Now, as a grandfather, I am still worried because it seems our situation has gotten worse. America is in **PERIL** , Peter.

_**[If you want to save America, can I personally ask you to join me in the Fight for Freedom? I am not giving up anytime soon but I am going to need a lot of help, especially with the Democrats pouring millions in Wisconsin.](https://email.vervemail.com/ct/60869126:6l5cFsVsN:m:1:3317145305:6E131B0D4F2420330A7EAE1555AD5CDA:r "johnson1")**_

body:
Tell Senate Republicans to join Bob and fellow Democrats in supporting a minimum wage increase today. [ ](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48274056/357636692/-744169294?refcode=Header&ms=Header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNGQ1MzJmNy0xZjBjLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a_QiW24G6bCMBdnI8e49hr7W0tekn9bgKOzHdEERWy0=&emci=6ac33b1e-f109-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=a4d532f7-1f0c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=8943725) Peter,

Three years ago, the House of Representatives passed the Raise the Wage Act, which would have raised the federal minimum wage for the first time since 2009.

Today, working families are still struggling to make ends meet, especially with the lingering economic effects of a global pandemic, Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and gas company price gouging. The time for action is long overdue.

The Raise the Wage Act would finally raise the minimum wage to $15, raise the tipped minimum wage, and index annual increases to wage growth overall so that families would no longer be forced to choose between paying their rent and feeding their children. Bob was proud to co-sponsor the bill, but Senate Republicans blocked a vote.

[**Tell Senate Republicans: "It's time to raise the minimum wage now!"**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48274057/357636693/701069195?ms=em22_220724_minwag_adv_gq_act___tc_ettx&refcode=em22_220724_minwag_adv_gq_act___tc_ettx&source=em22_220724_minwag_adv_gq_act___tc_ettx&utm_campaign=em22_220724_minwag_adv_gq_act___tc_ettx&utm_medium=email&contactdata=j66W2Ym3l%2F3IglOM86djtvgG%2FBNYeHnqXA4Vp5zjbLKkBmEKAOx7hjQ4gri6e5rbd4UzKrbUem12nDHcms98F9GbovwwAlyre3%2BsmHw8j00dPdvCzVN5hGrIrXlPweNZayIU%2BNBV68prvszkzGlwtSY6nmgEoREwFDw1%2BMxRlUJJdFEwinXU1l6ukPBlhYdP&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDU4NiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJhNGQ1MzJmNy0xZjBjLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=a_QiW24G6bCMBdnI8e49hr7W0tekn9bgKOzHdEERWy0=&emci=6ac33b1e-f109-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=a4d532f7-1f0c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=8943725) Day after day, too many workers are working full shifts for wages so artificially low that they're forced to rely on public assistance to pay their rent, feed their children, afford necessary medication, and pay for childcare.

If we'd raised the minimum wage to a fair wage at any time since the last increase in 2009, these workers could not only make ends meet on their own -- they could invest more in themselves, their families, and our economy.

We can't go back, but we can take action now. An increase in the minimum wage will put more dollars into our communities at a time when our country is fighting to recover from the economic effects of COVID-19. We have to build public pressure to help make it happen.

[**Add your name now. clean_body: Tell Senate Republicans to join Bob and fellow Democrats in supporting a minimum wage increase today. Peter, Three years ago, the House of Representatives passed the Raise the Wage Act, which would have raised the federal minimum wage for the first time since 2009. Today, working families are still struggling to make ends meet, especially with the lingering economic effects of a global pandemic, Russia's invasion of Ukraine, and gas company price gouging. The time for action is long overdue. The Raise the Wage Act would finally raise the minimum wage to $15, raise the tipped minimum wage, and index annual increases to wage growth overall so that families would no longer be forced to choose between paying their rent and feeding their children. Bob was proud to co-sponsor the bill, but Senate Republicans blocked a vote. Day after day, too many workers are working full shifts for wages so artificially low that they're forced to rely on public assistance to pay their rent, feed their children, afford necessary medication, and pay for childcare. If we'd raised the minimum wage to a fair wage at any time since the last increase in 2009, these workers could not only make ends meet on their own -- they could invest more in themselves, their families, and our economy. We can't go back, but we can take action now. An increase in the minimum wage will put more dollars into our communities at a time when our country is fighting to recover from the economic effects of COVID-19. We have to build public pressure to help make it happen. Thank you, Team Casey | PAID FOR BY BOB CASEY FOR SENATE INC. Bob Casey for Senate PO Box 58746 Philadelphia, PA 19102 United States

body:
Dear Friends,

Since the extreme Supreme Court’s unprecedented assault on our freedoms in the Dobbs ruling that overturned Roe v. Wade, our House Democrats have been the firewall to protect our rights. We have fought for your right to continue to choose the size and timing of your family, to marry whom you love, to vote in free and fair elections, and to thrive in a free society — but a supermajority of House Republicans have said NO to each of these measures to safeguard freedom and Democracy in America.

Today, Washington Post columnist Jennifer Rubin recognized our collective efforts to Defend our Democracy and safeguard our freedoms. As always, I accept every compliment on our work For The People on behalf of our courageous House Democrats who have acted to enshrine the protections of Roe v. Wade as federal law, to ensure the right to interstate travel, to protect access to contraception, and to respect marriage equality and interracial marriage this past week alone.

To you our VIPs, our volunteers in policy and in politics, none of our success would be possible without your support, moral clarity, and outside mobilization that make everything we do in the Congress with our inside maneuvering possible. I bring this article to your attention in gratitude for all you do and as a showcase and reminder of what we can accomplish when we work together.

We don’t agonize – we organize! Thank you and let’s keep up the fight.

Best regards,

NANCY

Opinion: Distinguished pol of the week: Her post-Dobbs strategy is working splendidly

By Jennifer Rubin

House Speaker Nancy Pelosi (D-Calif.) took charge of the national response to the Supreme Court’s decision in Dobbs v. Jackson Women’s Health Organization in a way no one in the White House, Senate or even pro-choice groups has been able to do. She understood that not only the court’s right-wing majority but also the Republican Party who put them on the bench were wildly out of step with the public.

So in a Dear Colleagues letter just days after the opinion was announced, she vowed to bring to the House floor measures that would protect “women’s most intimate and personal data stored in reproductive health apps”; affirm the “Constitutional right to travel freely and voluntarily throughout the United States”; and once more pass the Women’s Health Protection Act to make Roe v. Wade federal law.

But she did not stop there. She seized on Justice Clarence Thomas’s concurring opinion in Dobbs, which called for an even broader assault on privacy rights — including access to contraception, in-vitro fertilization and same-sex marriage.

She has made good on her promises. Earlier this month, the House passed the Women’s Health Protection Act and measures to protect the right to travel and information privacy, which Republicans opposed almost unanimously. In doing so, Republicans effectively put their stamp of approval on tech companies and governments rummaging through women’s phones to figure out whether and when they became pregnant. Republicans also own any state efforts to ban interstate travel for abortion patients.

Pelosi then put a bill protecting same-sex marriage on the floor. This time, the legislation lured 47 Republicans to vote yes, but the vast majority of Republicans voted against a now popular feature of American life.

Finally, on Thursday, Pelosi put on the floor a bill codifying the right to contraception, which Democratic, Republican and independent voters all overwhelmingly favor. Lo and behold, 195 Republicans voted against it. Democrats should be popping open the champagne. If ever there was a vote that epitomized the GOP’s extremism and disdainful view of women, this is it.

As Pelosi said on the House floor, “It’s outrageous that, nearly 60 years after Griswold was decided, women must once again fight for fundamental freedom to determine the size and timing of their families,” she said, referring to the court’s 1965 decision in Griswold v. Connecticut. She added, “But as Republicans turn back the clock on contraception, Democrats today are making it clear: We are not going back.”

The speaker was just getting warmed up: Controlling women’s options for contraception, she said, “is just another plank in the Republican extreme agenda for America.” She explained that the bill would establish an “unequivocal statutory right to obtain and use contraception,” affecting only the most “extremist state laws.”

It’s a matter of health, of “economic justice” and “a matter of fundamental freedom to make their own decisions about your own body and own life.” She reminded Republicans that the vast majority of Americans think they should have access to contraception.

She then lowered the boom: “Let us be clear: Those that oppose this legislation are only revealing their dark desire to punish and control America’s most intimate and personal decisions. . . .What is this about? They are against birth control, but they are for controlling women. This is about servitude.”

She couldn’t resist taunting Republicans. “I ask those who oppose contraception, again, do you even know what’s going on in your own families? Why don’t you ask? Do we need a session of the birds and bees to talk about why this is important?”

Democrats would be foolish not to feature this issue in every congressional race. At a moment when Democrats’ numbers are surging in generic congressional ballot polls, which measures which party voters prefer to control Congress, Pelosi has found an effective way to hoist Republicans with their own petard.

For reaffirming overwhelmingly popular positions on privacy rights, underscoring the extremism of the right-wing Supreme Court and exposing Republicans’ radically misogynistic views, we can say well done, Madam Speaker.

Nancy Pelosi is the Speaker of the U.S. House of Representatives.
As the top Democrat in the House, she's fighting to help working families and protect America from the dangerous agenda of Mitch McConnell and Kevin McCarthy.
We know you're getting a lot of emails -- but it's only because what we're facing right now as a country is so important.
Nancy is committed to doing whatever it takes to elect a record-breaking number of Democrats in the next election and beyond. Can we count on your support?

body:
Peter,
Over the weekend, in Tampa, neo-Nazis gathered outside a right-wing convention to cheer on Ron DeSantis — waving neo-Nazi flags, holding pictures of DeSantis, and spewing their hatred and bigotry.
This isn’t a standalone incident, Peter. It’s a pattern.
We’ve seen this happen across the state, from hateful flyers spread in South Florida to swastikas painted on temples and Holocaust museums.
And it has to end.
I’m calling on Ron DeSantis to forcefully condemn these neo-Nazis, forcefully condemn white supremacy, and start pushing back against the hatred he’s let fester in our state for three long years.
Will you join me, Peter? Add your name today to tell Ron DeSantis to take a real stand against hatred. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/VM4aUb83BUiHCJAWZOdF8Q2]
Stand Against Hate [https://secure.ngpvan.com/VM4aUb83BUiHCJAWZOdF8Q2]
Ron DeSantis is the Governor of over 22 million individuals — the Governor of a state with the third largest Jewish population in the country.
He needs to start condemning hatred and bigotry in our state, or he needs to get out of the way and make room for leaders who will .
I’m the first Jewish woman elected statewide in Florida, and I won’t back down from this fight. I’m ready to stand up to any challenge — to reject, condemn, and call for a united Florida against antisemitism, white supremacy, and hatred.
I will never be silent, and neither should you.
Thank you for joining me in this fight.
— Nikki

"Chris has dedicated his career to defending our Nation, our freedoms, and our democracy, first as an Iraq War veteran and later as a voting rights attorney. body:
Dear Friends & Supporters:

Vedat was all over the district this week speaking with voters about the issues that matter to them and why it is important that we have a Congress Member who works with Democrats and President Biden to get things done, rather than fight and criticize our fellow Democrats.
**_Fundraising_**
As noted in many media outlets, Vedat has raised the most money of any candidate in this race, and he has $100,000 cash on hand more than the incumbent with only one month left until primary day. The [New York Post](https://act.myngp.com/el/PLHUfRVWJdgr5fyx6Q3lh1XCi6ytgpLbZGm3RbkoKis=/cbom46xZLyYhVzpTd1VxRTDrd-HvAIbi9m0w82Kp5hA=) outlined Vedat's fundraising this weekend, calling him Bowman's "chief primary opponent." The Post also noted, " Rep. Jamaal Bowman -- despite the advantages of his incumbency -- also came up short to his chief primary opponent, Westchester County Legislator Vedat Gashi. Bowman's second quarter haul of $255,829, trailed Gashi's $301,366...Bowman has around $100,000 less cash on hand than Gashi heading into the home stretch."
**_Senator Jamaal Bailey BBQ in the Bronx_**
Vedat stopped by Senator Jamaal Bailey's barbecue in the Bronx on Saturday. The Bronx has always had a special meaning for him - it became his home after his family fled oppression in Kosovo. He always loves returning and connecting with voters (and Vedat can never turn down playing a game of chess!)
**_Candidate Forum_**
On Monday evening, Vedat participated in a candidate's forum hosted by the Scarsdale Democrats, the Mamaroneck Democrats, and the White Plains Democrats. You can view the forum [HERE](https://act.myngp.com/el/PLHUfRVWJdgr5fyx6Q3lh1XCi6ytgpLbZGm3RbkoKis=/5HxiRTHP9VaPjFJpeUEyN7K-YdtyBcqB7dCv3H6ELG4=?v=bXcycz2YQzc). He laid out his vision for NY-16 and stressed the importance of working with fellow Democrats on Democratic priorities, like implementing President Biden's infrastructure plan, strongly standing with our allies Israel and Ukraine, and protecting women's reproductive rights.
**_Door Knocking_**
Vedat spent the week knocking on doors and meeting voters in their communities across the district, from the Bronx to Greenburgh and Rye to Yonkers. Here are photos of him greeting commuters on their way to work at the Harrison Train Station and at their doors in Dobbs Ferry and Eastchester.
**_Volunteer with the campaign!_**
[Join us](https://act.myngp.com/el/PLHUfRVWJdgr5fyx6Q3lh1XCi6ytgpLbZGm3RbkoKis=/nKrcq1TnIFNilxQarHz1PLUKd1VYbHSyxOX5i1mo7Ws=) to talk to voters all across the district! We have volunteers knocking on doors, making phone calls, going to community events, and more. [Sign up](https://act.myngp.com/el/PLHUfRVWJdgr5fyx6Q3lh1XCi6ytgpLbZGm3RbkoKis=/nKrcq1TnIFNilxQarHz1PLUKd1VYbHSyxOX5i1mo7Ws=) to join the team now!!

Friends —
I have about 15 minutes to spare in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift.
And while I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success.
The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down.
We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money.
You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen.
But now we have a new mission: re-election.
And we’ve got our work cut out for us. The stakes were high before, but after last month it’s more critical than ever that we win this race. Because the Senate is now the final defense against a national abortion ban in the United States.
And in Arizona, the candidate that Trump just endorsed against me wants to go even further than the Supreme Court. He’s called for a national ban on abortion.
I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. Which is why I have to ask:

clean_body: | | | = Friends — I have about 15 minutes to spare in my schedule today. I know that doesn’t sound like a lot of time, but with a schedule like mine, I can assure you it’s a gift. And while I know our campaign sends a lot of emails your way, I want to take a few of those minutes to tell you about my decision to run for Senate in the first place — and why your support today is so important to our success. The truth is: When Gabby and I first started talking about running, we weren’t sure what to expect. We knew that Arizona needed new leadership in the Senate — someone who would always put the people of our state first, who was willing to work across the aisle to deliver real results, and who would prioritize building bridges between the two parties — not burning them down. We also knew we had some friends who would help us out. But when you’re talking about such a big campaign, we realized we’d need support from a lot of people we hadn’t met yet as well. Especially since I was making the decision to reject corporate PAC money. You know the rest... we won in 2020 in large part because we ran the biggest grassroots campaign Arizona has ever seen. But now we have a new mission: re-election. And we’ve got our work cut out for us. The stakes were high before, but after last month it’s more critical than ever that we win this race. Because the Senate is now the final defense against a national abortion ban in the United States. And in Arizona, the candidate that Trump just endorsed against me wants to go even further than the Supreme Court. He’s called for a national ban on abortion. I know times are tough, but we can’t give in now. We need to make sure a ban like that never happens. "They wasted surplus revenue that could have been returned to taxpayers to offset the high cost of living or put toward Local Aid. Even worse, they put politics ahead of passing legislation to prevent violence against women -- legislation that I steadfastly support.

I know my opponent, Maura Healey, lacks the courage or the political will to stand up to her allies in the Legislature. She sides with the establishment; I side with the people, and I'm not afraid. I urge Governor Baker to line-item veto every single piece of political pork and send it back to the Legislature. And, I urge the Legislature to pass the Governor's anti-domestic violence legislation forthwith. Send the ruling party on Beacon Hill a message on behalf of all Bay Staters -- no more waiting, no more wasteful spending, no more games. The people have had enough!"

It wouldn’t be right to go another day without expressing my gratitude for your unwavering support of my re-election campaign.

As Election Day nears, I’m taking some time to think back over the events that unfolded during my first term as Governor.

Do you remember Biden’s Democrat allies in the legacy media running to cover for Dr. Fauci by supporting unscientific lockdowns and the harmful masking of our children?

Or the Biden administration blatantly and disgracefully colluding with Big Tech to silence free speech and cancel all dissent during the pandemic?

Fortunately, they were not the only ones with access to COVID data…

As Governor of Florida, I reached out to and spoke with some of the best scientists and doctors in the world at Harvard, Stanford, and Oxford to assess the necessity of the Left’s destructive lockdown policies.

The data showed the Left’s draconian policies were failures, and I kept Florida open. And I’m glad I did.

Every American has a right to work.

Every business has a right to operate.

That’s why I stepped in and stopped local governments from restricting people from working or operating a business.
https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=899a88070652a53db9a0f4614853d0a851b513865d02a82bc1d019b5b5789ecf12ca77cecde576fd722f2c1f51d5b25d1e95d99fb48f7d68
>>">Do you support my decision to keep Florida open? Stand with me now. >>>

I even issued pardons for those who were threatened by local governments with jail and ridiculous fines for operating during the pandemic.

I put my entire political career on the line to Keep Florida Free. I fought back.

It showed you exactly the kind of leader I am. I don’t cower with fear about what the media may say — I just lead.

In 2019, when I was inaugurated as Florida’s 46th Governor, I didn’t let the grass grow under my feet before turning the Tallahassee establishment upside down.

I immediately fulfilled several of my key campaign promises to Floridians, including:

✅ Changing the Florida Supreme Court for a generation by appointing three rock-solid conservative justices.

✅ Signing the largest expansion of school choice in the nation, giving parents greater freedom to choose the education that best meets their child’s needs.

✅ Restoring election integrity by holding election officials accountable by accepting the resignation of Broward County Supervisor of Elections Brenda Snipes from public office, as well as suspending Palm Beach County Election Supervisor Susan Bucher.

✅ Suspending Broward County Sheriff Scott Israel for his failure to protect the students at Marjorie Stoneman Douglas High School during the massacre at Parkland in 2018.

Of course, making these moves during my first few days in office was just a preview of what I set out to accomplish.

Over my first three years, I’ve continued to steer Florida to a strong, safe, prosperous future with liberty as my guide and the Constitutions as my north star.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=899a88070652a53db9a0f4614853d0a851b513865d02a82bc1d019b5b5789ecf12ca77cecde576fd722f2c1f51d5b25d1e95d99fb48f7d68
Do you think Florida is headed in the right direction? Rush in any amount now to keep our accomplishments going for another four years!

I refuse to simply kick the can down the road or seek out the path of least resistance when it comes to doing the right thing.

I certainly don’t set my priorities according to what is preferred by Silicon Valley’s CEOs, Big Tech’s shady algorithms, or the corrupt media’s agenda!

I refuse to bow to pressure from the Biden administration, kiss the ring of power-hungry government bureaucrats like Fauci, or follow orders from woke corporations who want to dictate to us how to live and what to think.

I was elected to lead, not to follow.

As was the case when I was in the U.S. Navy, my mission has always been to advocate for the people I serve.

I’m proud that because of my work these last few years, Florida is known as the freest state in the country.

Yet rather than celebrate our economy, our school children being freed of compulsory masking, and the influx of overtaxed Americans who are voting with their feet to move to Florida, I am being attacked by my Democrat opponents.

I know you understand that coordinated attacks and vitriol against a successful conservative Republican like me is business as usual from the lockdown Democrats. It’s pathetic to see my political opponents and detractors whine about my record of accomplishments.

As Governor of Florida, I’ll never stop defending the pro-liberty, pro-free market policies that make Florida the beachhead of freedom for the nation.

My re-election campaign sent SHOCK WAVES through the Democrat media complex when we announced a $5 MILLION ad reservation targeting Hispanic voters.

With the Biden regime publicly cozying up to communist dictators in Cuba and Venezuela, you can be sure every victim of communism across the state is more willing than ever to reject the Democrat Party's choice for Governor this November.

I’m going to battle for every vote.

As you may remember, I narrowly won by a margin of just 0.4% four years ago during my first race for Governor!

We truly must be prepared for another knock-down, drag-out fight.

Now, with just months to go until Election Day, I’m asking you to stand with me again by making another generous contribution to my campaign today.

With November fast approaching, I’m hoping you can double your most generous gift.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=899a88070652a53db9a0f4614853d0a851b513865d02a82bc1d019b5b5789ecf12ca77cecde576fd722f2c1f51d5b25d1e95d99fb48f7d68
[PLEDGE YOUR GIFT NOW]

Regardless of the amount, I simply must have your continued support to be ready to respond to the next round of distortions and lies my Biden-loving opponents hurl at me.

Peter, I’m incredibly grateful to you for your continued support.

No matter the amount, I thank you in advance for continuing to stand with me as I lead by example and fight back against the heavy hand of Biden’s big government.

For Florida,
Ron DeSantis

body:
Here's the deal: Republicans are spending more than $21 million to flip this seat.
| | | [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48283934/357674278/-1829049351?refcode=mh-jtk1325-fr-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNDAvMS84ODg1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI1YWQyNTE1OC0yZjBjLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=YvwPQUdeWy11-gqKFtd9jPtFWLLjpW8NALKIt-KSCbY=)
---
Hi there –
I hate asking for money. My focus continues to be on fighting for the issues that matter most to Granite Staters. Issues like commonsense gun safety, reproductive rights, and climate change to name a few – that need urgent action.
**But here's the deal: Republicans are spending more than $21 million to flip this seat.** Far-right GOP groups are flooding the airwaves with attack ads – and in a swing state like New Hampshire, that could be the difference between winning and losing.
No one likes political ads. But they're a reality of campaigning, especially in a race this tight. If we're going to fight back against the GOP's attacks and protect this seat, we need the resources to keep our own ads on the air.

Whether you are middle or low income or anything in between, Vermonters... | | |
---
| | For far too long, we have been barreling through a housing shortage that has only gotten worse. From Canaan to Brattleboro, from St. Albans to Bennington, so many Vermonters and people trying to move here have no where to go. Rents are way above affordable and purchasing homes is out of reach for most. The thing is we can do better.

Brenda has been fighting for access to housing for years. On October 14th, 2021, Brenda stood on the Statehouse steps and said that she would not leave until the Governor fully reinstated the emergency housing program that houses our neighbors and community members experiencing homelesn, sople thought they could not win, but they won.

[Support Vermonters need for housing ](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=bec3bf30df&e=eb0e94ee98)[with a Donation of $50 today](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=ec71cccb8d&e=eb0e94ee98)!

After a tumultuous few weeks, we want to hear YOUR thoughts on Glenn Youngkin’s job performance.

|

Derek, It’s been a rough few weeks for Glenn Youngkin. He announced a proposed 15-week ban on abortion – while saying that he’d sign ANY abortion restriction that landed on his desk, seemingly including outlawing it entirely. He lied on national television, claiming that same-sex marriage is already enshrined into law in Virginia (it’s not), while also dodging questions on whether or not he supported marriage equality. He appointed a Confederate apologist to Virginia’s Board of Historic Resources, who proclaimed that Robert E. subject: We can do better
body:
Whether you are middle or low income or anything in between, Vermonters... | | |
---
| | For far too long, we have been barreling through a housing shortage that has only gotten worse. From Canaan to Brattleboro, from St. Albans to Bennington, so many Vermonters and people trying to move here have no where to go. Rents are way above affordable and purchasing homes is out of reach for most. The thing is we can do better.

Brenda has been fighting for access to housing for years. On October 14th, Brenda stood on the Statehouse steps and said that she would not leave until the Governor fully reinstated the emergency housing program that houses our neighbors and community members experiencing homelessness.

It took 27 nights, but as Brenda says, she "could not walk off those steps if other people were going to freeze to death". Right up until the 28th day, many people thought that they could not win. But they won!
---
| [Donate To Bring Housing To All Vermonters](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=14dc98035a&e=eb0e94ee98 "Donate To Bring Housing To All Vermonters")

---
| We need proactive leadership now on what matters most. We need a leader that shows up for Vermonters every time. We need a plan that addresses emergency, transitional housing and permanent housing. We can't just put down a plan that looks good on paper, it has to meet need. We need Brenda now and we can't do that without you.
[Support Vermonters need for housing ](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=15af3263f9&e=eb0e94ee98)[with a Donation of $50 today](https://brendaforvermont.us13.list-manage.com/track/click?u=224771580cedf68826482245c&id=75679b8cca&e=eb0e94ee98)!

subject: BLM vs BLEXIT
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zn40mr8hco98a2t6hkno0it4nj6aq0v7vfl9edp0_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37d1m65qbfctjmkrncst66uqrf91ieoob9crl6uie5sj2ulqr1olgckpn1c9gmhpnatdgm4p3eo3kctg68ppk6pir0ppjejie2t756li6ao37q9o74oj6e2p6cs74mdhm0shgcpon1ddk6upbcphhm2p6co70mlhm1o5l64oracdle8gq48bi4bh28or5c3jm6pb2cdim49fg)
[](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zq98ik87280islhqkcuvpcglkbkbco7k91jlsk98_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrkei163rjledkkg84s0nsqfiucd3oq3n834urs8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zcn6uspmm3i9pd4s8hpmde2t199pk80pc89k12pg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z53ga3shbron6auajm8p563vnb45uam85hpab7u8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zbjgh55d22g65j223he0i5g08r14l7ahhoku03mg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)

[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z9cagv1i47cles9pb93fibpurf7vtujb7bi94hhg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zp38vu0ags3n4u4abnjbo0pstf0df242ptlftak8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)

[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zpvqkhtq90oaprl8eos1uscj95j4l22ph0t7bo00_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zj8n5uhu6ocqldo3gr2m1siminss0fsl6gt1beto_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zrr6dgifh5i3r8qd4a8ed4lds0092oh5fat1rnio_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zqolv4n5lifhn8ghooc50r66nu3uadsldit47c70_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zg7molntb5cmj33jhi7pta3mdim7e53hti9ukqj0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2ztl67tbcusdno1kem46cva2vs88c2cl5l362feh8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z4ss48p34kvkro8sn0l1hnk6e8b8508n29dn5l3o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zibjaadqgtcfkj7u7k2jc5urnav4pk8p7p07lg08_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z2qecej83i917mhpko0lbk02b15mm3jc7fq0snng_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zan8bp6a1g0p61k0if6vt18immafdqtjkbo0v9u0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmaoj3clh2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a “DO” tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

| FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE MONDAY, JULY 25, 2022
BURT JONES STATEMENT ON HUGE LEGAL VICTORY OVER FULTON COUNTY DA FANI WILLIS AND CHARLIE BAILEY'S CAMPAIGN
JACKSON, Ga. - Today, State Senator and Conservative businessman Burt Jones issued the following statement after Fulton County Judge Robert McBurney granted his motion to disqualify Fulton County District Attorney Fani Willis from her investigation into Senator Jones. This is a huge win for Burt's campaign for Lieutenant Governor, and a huge loss for Charlie Bailey's entire campaign platform. To read the a copy of the full ruling, click [HERE](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0015HhM_luL-Ar-JRTzMAWv2a7-HXuGSddvWZulouCZxtSOBdR8LgA--_dxmkovItiGGWsEUPRWdwNUxQbk-GV79otZFCiMYntcyWfUT72DlVMar5L8YEMsmkxFVnc_UkqpzMuclu6zow-gaPseDGVB3kfLd0Y0EceqdJyV5S3rdIwYQ4fb8jb8_fUHXYtyyjk9jZnERXnvWbQIzLfyaGwlvrz3n4_aT6wrCmaeRHdVcDI=&c=IPufiSFRPUxNG3MbcGolfMplx_zbZJzppJGXuo8DmW5rUWMcINDbTg==&ch=NAqT_yjbjet60KWCXNeZTJSyeVMPUn9pKdxLQumGJaGhmIm19uwMsg==).
Burt Jones said, "Today's ruling is a huge win for our campaign--but more importantly, for due process and the rule of law in Georgia. If Fani Willis and Charlie Bailey spent half as much time addressing real issues as they did grandstanding and using their offices to score political points, Atlanta might not have the record number of homicides that it does under their watch. While Charlie Bailey continues to run a smear campaign devoid of any substance, we're going to spend our time talking about solutions to real issues that Georgians are facing every day--lowering costs at the grocery store and the gas pump, creating more high-quality jobs, improving our K-12 education system, and making our communities safer. That's what real leaders do--and that's what our campaign will remain focused on."

name: Brandon Tatum
subject: BLM vs Blexit
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A
[View this message in your browser](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zosniv1fjjl81iss4vhfg4m179jdek0dum2fh6f8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpqedtge1p7adjkm4qj7cbkmgor79hnmmrq8cjm62qb6t9nkjhf4onhmpojap7769qe1dlj6go76db4clrm4o5mesqbcopm6jjr6c3165q62ctk6gqneduie1p68dhgm9j74t1hepge1d3563gbacb4spj6ccdn6kqjfcjmcooj9cr2cuobapbi4no)
[](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zukf4ohg3j4d0j4jbk90cg9h49onohpctflcfkj8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjmbli4765d1jom7l5i58f1kpaouqv4dvimaa4eg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zepuf5lj1614v7dgvfenkgab5lkukmcstvfq8dcg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I've copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z0kijpmda95d7qu2ifeb39eu75oevfnol2737mg0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zr5fggvtkiam73ku0bdsltugi9h5jq1agju27pig_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zdfbsh3nte0gm1m2olqgs0rdv3jl4e963it8dtqg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zne35ecb7lg9mofdbv0vf6c5p79hbmmacojj4em8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zks1rbq0ck6gra2d5co9pmd7mpnl0aauuafmrh1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjvui0ac090scjvt2883tehjtb0umubn98k8p1hg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zfc7lp4c214stt430fgfl0goaec286tk71a9i070_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zsmpgu9lat8jetdstegrhm06j0ja01ft1tkpsaj0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zgpji3c7sndn3k8pljstm9u3l74v1q97f1nqpur0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a "DO" tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zmjjoe0pde8n8a4f80gsu9oqutnbb08pvfqv64i8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zpfdm11t56olbj4b8s63uvu1ts6csmdgj4nueqro_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z6a0a7sap4k6m4ae0g3a6m5jbksisgagvgkd95d0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zrdmgcu52264p3gm7pt5ctc1pjfc5gc4s6sior1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zjtktn23470m6u7o2peuqujf8ghrvaatd2rfdf1g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zem0lbudou0ajmaerumms2724q7sq5amva3i9940_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zd6n68vo1omrkv7t1l6g5t7s9hfclf7hrbj5abng_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1f2e5194mrrgr3r8saulpllm07gc94f4gpnam1o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zki22sqnpsmoub7qog4rqvhn8dru4gsbp9og23t8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthm6or4c5h2bs)

People ask me, "What does BLEXIT mean?"

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_" If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor." \- Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of A

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I 'm telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - _Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you're thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, "what about them is influential?!"

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren't, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That 's why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America 's black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I'll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zh7u4qq54rjkko8f7can8orppc3rp6pa47cttcn8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmeoj0s1h2bs)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the "Black Lives Matter" organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn't have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I'm giving back to the Black community to make sure they don't become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://e.deroymurdock.com/rd/9z2zah9e17mpf25lmau6ck657m2o2n222rjuohlhc3g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0sthmeoj0s1h2bs)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here 's how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

# **Friend — Democrats and the woke left are spreading one myth after another in the wake of the Dobbs ruling. **

---
One of the most common ones I hear is about ectopic pregnancies. Like all OB-GYNs — including pro-life OB-GYNs — I commonly treated ectopic pregnancies and miscarriages during my 25+ years in medicine. Neither are an abortion, and the Democrats’ myth that this will change after Dobbs is out of touch with reality.
I’ve written an op-ed for _Fox News_ that sets the record straight about this, as well as about the other myths the woke left is spreading. [**I hope you’ll read it now, and share it with your friends.**](http://ci.criticalimpact.com/go/1/80611874979feca4041ad8cde91a9694/37973/7dfe8a3d786d7abf/7471e2a06e3fd1c9c3d6b838967d376c/37973)

And that's exactly what I'm doing. But I can't keep up the fight without your help. We're facing an onslaught from the woke left, and Democrats across the country are raising millions to keep their power. I'm not about to back down, but I need you standing with me. If you're able, I hope you'll chip in below. Taking back the Senate in 2022 depends on patriots like you standing with us. -Senator Roger Marshall
