name: Brandon Tatum
subject: Most hateful organization in America
body:
I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America - Black Lives Matter. [](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/BC.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c210334%7c9423%7c8%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz%7c805&wdmdk=nTVku%2fDYJ0DnhxXbFzr4fA&sysid=1)
[](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39593%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KxE4%2biLYl0UW%2f96uzXV17g&sysid=1)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39594%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=rvnRKbVU1mTHnE4vZyes%2bg&sysid=1)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39505%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KU9gJqCebInEk2QquZL%2b7g&sysid=1)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here’s how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today:

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39506%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FC58JJbrBxDkOwiIFcTxOA&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39507%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=k0uWqvIgSAJCS6gNC%2fn6gA&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $50 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39508%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=LuloKmipsvfjK%2b8MuCny4g&sysid=1)

[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39500%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Lv2epeJT%2fpFpcO8U755zvA&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39501%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=s6qx%2bUo37tBqZ9j%2ftwLCRg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39502%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RqWqf%2bXDtzJntrM4QczUIQ&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39503%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KhJ%2b%2bnoG%2bjPjs%2fzfMVun3A&sysid=1)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39504%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YRt4kZfr5YJ0HAHjmwR3iw&sysid=1)

**HOW BLEXIT Works**

**Step One:** We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods.

**Step Two:** We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy.

We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time.

Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses.

As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them.

**Step Three:** Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media.

BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families.

**Step Four:** We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities.

What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a “DO” tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods.

Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man.

We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods.

**So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. **

[_**Donate $10 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39506%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=FC58JJbrBxDkOwiIFcTxOA&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $35 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39507%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=k0uWqvIgSAJCS6gNC%2fn6gA&sysid=1)

[_**Donate $100 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39509%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=n3lBmSoaqWXGzY8Kh%2bjywg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $250 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39500%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=Lv2epeJT%2fpFpcO8U755zvA&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $500 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39501%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=s6qx%2bUo37tBqZ9j%2ftwLCRg&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $1,000 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39502%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RqWqf%2bXDtzJntrM4QczUIQ&sysid=1)
[_**Donate $2,500 >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39503%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=KhJ%2b%2bnoG%2bjPjs%2fzfMVun3A&sysid=1)
[_**Donate Any Amount >>>**_](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c39504%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=YRt4kZfr5YJ0HAHjmwR3iw&sysid=1)

People ask me, “What does BLEXIT mean?”

It is the Black exit from the culture of victimhood, fear, and dependence the media has forced on us.

_“If you hold a permanent view of yourself as a victim, you become your own oppressor.” - Candace Owens_

We believe in Faith, Freedom, and Family. With those three principles intact, you can find prosperity no matter how your life may have started. And I believe that is what will save us all in the end.

Thank you,

Brandon Tatum
Co-Founder
BLEXIT Foundation

subject: Take the National Survey on Socialism
body:
A few years ago, New York magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?"
[View this message in your browser](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zh2ki4c1nulv707h3ijh6pj1c4ohhnc143me0a7o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm0oj6cjh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq0sjnm6qb6d9le1oj8cbl6ej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hf3dplmhprfcjnc3hb6o9h6mqe5d3kecon5dj6mtj38t34m8p7ac5nmgrjbcdh6srt4s3ic9j71cj6e3ib6or0e8o6csbimmo6fcljcopb1cj6c3gbaor0s2qj2cdl66qn49fg)
| | | This sponsored message from Pro Life Update is on behalf of Hillsdale College [](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zrfrqmfi0esm0skhsa0d8i5m9bq1madu069t479o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm0oj6cjh2bs)
---
| |
Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York_ magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2zvt2th3qivnvnp5vvvr73ko27aas34hc0d4aqvmg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm0oj6cjh2bs)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages.** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly.** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism** in the next five days**,** your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://e.prolifeupdate.com/rd/9z2z43ssfgihbgfpao66mdksmkfa8fdkn1sfd6rlf70_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm0oj6cjh2bs)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844
---

### **Walk with Me!**
---
Dear FriendThe August 23rd Republican Primary for Congress is just 29 days away and my team and I are working hard to earn the votes of the people of the 7th District.I hope you’ve seen our ads on TV, online, or received our mailings. If not, please visit [www.tededwardsforcongress.com](https://f69e.engage.squarespace-mail.com/r?m=62ded95fdda4f65b177e00d2&u=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tededwardsforcongress.com%3Fss_source%3Dsscampaigns%26ss_campaign_id%3D62dc00a6bd5052770603bb1b%26ss_email_id%3D62ded95fdda4f65b177e00d2%26ss_campaign_name%3DWalk%2Bwith%2Bme%2Bthis%2BSaturday%26ss_campaign_sent_date%3D2022-07-25T17%253A57%253A15Z&w=62a23ccb05070a1330f6e585&l=en-US&s=mKTjbOvbecdbqWs4Y8RbmO0f5lY%3D).Nothing is more impactful to win voters than door-to-door campaigning, and I have to tell you, I’ve really enjoyed talking to people in the community and the feedback has energized Nikki and me for the battle ahead.**I’d like to ask you to consider joining us this Saturday, July 30, from 9:30 to 12:30 to walk precincts and pass out materials to voters.** If you are not comfortable walking, we will have other volunteer activities on that day and can also fit your walk for another time to meet your schedule. Please RSVP to [ted@tededwardsforcongress.com](mailto:ted@tededwardsforcongress.com) if you can meet us at 460 W. State Road 436, Suite 101, Casselberry FL.I hope you will take a few hours to help our campaign. This has been quite a journey for me and I’d love to have you on the final ride with me!

Team, when we talk about how basic civil rights are on the line in this race, this is what we mean:

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48290581/357700117/-4707655?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDUvMS83MDIyOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjODliODUyYi00MzBjLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=yvOMVYMNR9b0HywJQ9kdbrVGT6uasiIOQvyB7qxdl1o=&emci=d051d9aa-360c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&emdi=c89b852b-430c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&ceid=19954364) Team, when we talk about how basic civil rights are on the line in this race, this is what we mean: After the Supreme Court’s horrific decision to overturn Roe v. Wade, the House took a vote on legislation to protect the right to access contraception. body:
Peter Willis, are you ready to vote?

Washington's Primary Day is NEXT WEEK, and today is the last day you can register early! **[Double check your voter registration now.](https://act.myngp.com/el/zIZU-NiYYBAN5z6KLwb7-7qZe1Wo1aXp-etnCwcV0hA=/j8WhOlgzg3_8HMugQZb3uxs8OwM98maSSmm43EG5Nxs=)**

Derek is relying on every single person on this grassroots team to use their voice and cast their ballot. If you're registered and ready to vote, **[then don't forget to check your drop box location and drop off your ballot!](https://act.myngp.com/el/zIZU-NiYYBAN5z6KLwb7-7qZe1Wo1aXp-etnCwcV0hA=/1sDPtS96kyrq5UmKdgPORh2cP0u3AfTgyKGQ5z1bbx0=)**

Thanks for being a part of the fight.

\---------- Forwarded message ---------
From: Derek Kilmer
Date: Wed, Jul 20, 2022
Subject: I voted. Have you?

Team --
In less than two weeks, it'll be Primary Day in Washington. This is our first real chance to fight for our freedoms at the ballot box and continue our fight for a democracy that works for the people.

I've already dropped off my ballot, but if you haven't yet -- make sure to drop your ballot off before 8 p.m. on August 2! **[You can find your drop box location here.](https://act.myngp.com/el/zIZU-NiYYBAN5z6KLwb7-7qZe1Wo1aXp-etnCwcV0hA=/1sDPtS96kyrq5UmKdgPORh2cP0u3AfTgyKGQ5z1bbx0=)**

[](https://act.myngp.com/el/zIZU-NiYYBAN5z6KLwb7-7qZe1Wo1aXp-etnCwcV0hA=/1sDPtS96kyrq5UmKdgPORh2cP0u3AfTgyKGQ5z1bbx0=)
[FIND YOUR DROP BOX](https://act.myngp.com/el/zIZU-NiYYBAN5z6KLwb7-7qZe1Wo1aXp-etnCwcV0hA=/1sDPtS96kyrq5UmKdgPORh2cP0u3AfTgyKGQ5z1bbx0=)
The deadline to update your voter registration status online and by mail is next Monday, July 25. **[Make sure you're registered and ready to vote by checking your voter registration status right now.](https://act.myngp.com/el/zIZU-NiYYBAN5z6KLwb7-7qZe1Wo1aXp-etnCwcV0hA=/j8WhOlgzg3_8HMugQZb3uxs8OwM98maSSmm43EG5Nxs=)** You can still register to vote in person during business hours and any time before 8 p.m. on Election Day.

Team, I'm committed to helping people in our area who are struggling, but I can't do this important work alone. I ask for your vote, so we can continue to help folks in our community, stand up for reform, and get our government working for the people.

These past few months prove the future of reproductive freedom, voting rights, the economy, and our environment is on the line. It's crucial you make your voice heard loud and clear this year -- for our region and for our future.

Our grassroots movement has been leading up to this moment, so please, **[double and triple-check your registration before the July 25 deadline.](https://act.myngp.com/el/zIZU-NiYYBAN5z6KLwb7-7qZe1Wo1aXp-etnCwcV0hA=/j8WhOlgzg3_8HMugQZb3uxs8OwM98maSSmm43EG5Nxs=)**

It's an honor to serve you,

Derek

**Derek Kilmer is leading the efforts to reform our democracy and break through the partisan gridlock so that Congress works for the people. Chip in today to support his grassroots campaign.**

subject: Help me tell Liz Cheney – “You’re fired!”
body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country...
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z55thd6itp7clrqcti90pcifonl5n33gvaktubc8_rp2ash2s8gb2sbgebjqf99jkgqracjkmoq37c9l6cqj7djl6eqjetjjkorrbdt469r31d5jekrq9onicbor3cb6e2o74crkshh36s766cob0olge3ij6ptjmdo6bcdmciqeeodickprbcb0sv970sj46oob4pjiegonco70mhij1o5l65iecpj666rjad9ge9p6cd34mmp6fc5lclp238h1e8he4933clgeepr2c1im2oh5u)
This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zslmlhqhi1aaddr9kj2nbe45trsqcs3tl1omatfg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3c2q079fg0lnbhkpop9msmpojv86fsniimncfio_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zniag2qu2rsptqh360og676b01lnjfug6q28ftno_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate - they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know - like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z3ej9p6jg8jn6tilfkbfgi2nrof919nmou8eogl8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z0osihns8nr7n7su24of2fi3rhno6qcq0brv3sto_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming - and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

...unlike Cheney, who spends more time fist-bumping Joe Biden and complimenting Nancy Pelosi than she does fighting back against big government bureaucrats who _waste our tax dollars_ , _fling open our borders_ , and _silence, censor, and even lock up conservatives_ who disagree!

**But even though I have President Trump's complete and total endorsement, there's one endorsement I still need: yours.**

[**Will you make an donation today to show President Trump that you're still a part of his MAGA-America First Movement?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2z418giev24imvord7v4brfed3d41nk9qhdjj7rpg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zoqrkello7ki06rj8lr0cf164one695gqvljn38g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
You should know that, even though polls show Cheney is grossly unpopular in Wyoming, she still thinks she can win re-election.

**In fact, when liberal _60 Minutes_ asked her if she could beat me in the primary, she said "absolutely...this is going to be the most important House race in the country."**

Well, she was right about something - this will be the most important race in the entire country - but only because it will be the first step in saving America from the big government elites who enable Joe Biden.

Again, I'll need your help to beat her.

As I said, Cheney can count on the deep pocketbooks of the entire establishment.

That's not even saying anything for her left-wing supporters, who see this as their chance to weaken our Republican Party for good.

**But with your help, I know we can beat them. And I know we can send the disastrous Cheney political dynasty packing for good.**

[**So please, won't you ensure that Liz Cheney bury me, a true conservative, with money from her swampy elite friends?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zselg74po8ha1cjsfjik5b7gib5su6grgd2o0vi8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zijh936hdl0ph364m3gtq62h5ck07k7g5ls7k7dg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
Liz Cheney represents everything the left stands for, and everything we must fight against.

Will you help me make sure we win that fight?

Respectfully,
[](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2znevel4obsk99q8su7i6ldblrq3dq16hci3qn7mg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)
Harriet Hageman
America First Conservative for Congress (WY)

P.S. It's disgusting to see Liz Cheney teaming up with George Bush to demonize conservatives and raise millions to back Nancy Pelosi's unconstitutional power grabs in Congress.

It's even more disgusting to watch her claim she speaks for the people of Wyoming and America.

[**No more - will you make an urgent donation to my campaign to defeat her in the Republican primary?**](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2zei0046ev4frvb6v3buejs3tup4ouvkkirvgsmg8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)

[DONATE NOW](http://e.americandefensenews.com/rd/9z2za6cbjkn0vrqn3k8v52utb678i6qaabu81d2rt0g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stjm4o35c5h2bs)

Mail-in ballots were sent out last week and Pinellas County Republicans are eager for change by electing Amanda Makki this November, but we need your help to get out the vote!

Team Makki

All the evidence reinforced the fact that Trump betrayed his oath to the American people again and again. And that he, and those around him, present a clear and present danger to our democracy.
The 1/6 Committee has presented the case and now the Justice Department must act to hold those who have broken laws to account. It’s up to Democrats to present a clear roadmap forward for America — one that reflects our values and meets the needs of this moment. And we must start by defeating Trump Republicans right here in Maryland, and in Ohio, Georgia, Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, and across the country.

clean_body: This is a historically consequential moment for our democracy. = Last week the January 6th panel revealed chilling new evidence from that infamous day. Secret Service agents protecting the Vice President "in fear of their own lives" from Trump’s mob and calling loved ones to say goodbye. Video footage showing Trump refusing his aides' requests to utter the words “the election is over” in his public remarks on January 7th. All the evidence reinforced the fact that Trump betrayed his oath to the American people again and again. And that he, and those around him, present a clear and present danger to our democracy. The 1/6 Committee has presented the case and now the Justice Department must act to hold those who have broken laws to account. One thing is crystal clear — the Republican Party has disqualified itself as a credible governing alternative. It’s up to Democrats to present a clear roadmap forward for America — one that reflects our values and meets the needs of this moment. And we must start by defeating Trump Republicans right here in Maryland, and in Ohio, Georgia, Wisconsin, Pennsylvania, and across the country. In addition to the House and the Senate, we need to elect strong Democratic leaders in states across the country. In Maryland, Democratic nominee for Governor Wes Moore faces a Trump Republican in November who has stated that President Trump's policies are the policies he wants to bring to the state of Maryland. And in Pennsylvania, Michigan, Wisconsin, Georgia and elsewhere the outcome of tough Governors races will determine the political climate not only in those states, but surrounding the 2024 Presidential election. This is a historically consequential moment for our democracy. The outcome of the November elections will determine whether we will be able to take action to address the urgent issues our democracy faces — or fall back into the dystopia of the Trump Republican Party. 106 days to November 8th. Let's make each of them count! Peter, My family escaped communist Vietnam after my father was put on a kill list. And even coming here as a child, I knew that I was a part of something special.

Peter – Today, our democracy is facing attacks from all sides. **As MAGA extremists continue spreading lies about the 2020 election, they're pushing dangerous laws ****through state legislatures ****that _actually_ threaten our democracy and undermine the right to vote.**
**This year alone, 27 states have introduced at least 150 bills making it harder to vote – and 64% of Americans believe our democracy is “in crisis and at risk of failing.”** Right now, we need Congress to take bold, decisive action to defend the right to vote and strengthen our democracy – but gridlock and partisanship are blocking any progress.
That's why it's so critical that we protect our Senate majority and elect strong candidates who will cut through the noise and get this legislation across the finish line. **Trudy Busch Valentine, a former nurse and fourth-generation Missourian, will work her heart out to pass the John Lewis Voting Rights Advancement Act.** This bill will ensure that every voter has equal access to the ballot box. It will reduce the effects of partisan gerrymandering and remove many barriers that voters, particularly African Americans, face.
**You can count on Trudy to be a fierce defender of our democracy and lead with honesty and integrity every time. **With so many lies and dirty politics in Washington, we need a leader we can trust – a leader like Trudy.

Peter,

I’m going to make this the shortest email you’ve received from me in a long time.
1. **We’re down by 1 point in the most recent publicly available poll**

2. Republicans are having a really hard time raising campaign cash, despite the fact that **85% of Americans think we’re on the wrong track as a country**

3. **I don’t have enough money to start airing my ads on TV and we have less than 110 days until Election Day**

4. **It costs $7k to air one of my ads on TV per day. Every day we’re not on TV, we’re losing this race**

With Republicans only needing 4 seats to capture the House, victory is within reach. But the fundraising gap between DEMS and REPUBS is bewildering.
**
I need immediate help. We have not aired a single ad on TV because it’s so expensive. I’m asking if you’ll help me avoid budget cuts by chipping in to fill up my TV ad fund today. We need to raise $7,000 by tonight at midnight to be able to air our ads tomorrow.**

name: Dan Goldman
subject: Fighting to expand abortion access
disclaimer_text: Paid for by DAN GOLDMAN FOR NY
body:
Hi Peter —

Our nation is facing a five-alarm fire that too many politicians are treating as a distant flame. With Roe v. Wade now overturned, Republican-led state legislatures are systematically ripping away the fundamental right to abortion. We must act.

We need to meet this moment with new, creative, and aggressive tactics. I will work tirelessly to pass progressive legislation on choice that codifies and expands the right to bodily autonomy for this generation and generations to come. As your next representative from NY-10, I will fight to:

1. Expand abortion access and codify Roe v. Wade into law
2. Repeal the Hyde Amendment
3. Ensure abortion medication can be accessed via telehealth and mail-order pharmacies across state lines without state interference
4. Allow clinics on federal land and near state lines in red states to provide abortion access
5. Increase funding to VA hospitals to provide medical care for miscarriages, ectopic pregnancies, and IVF
6. Increase funding for access to contraception, birth control and education

I unequivocally believe in a woman's right to an abortion. I always have and always will. And I will fight tirelessly to expand abortion access when I’m in Congress.

In solidarity,
Dan Goldman

Dan Goldman is running for Congress to protect our democracy and defend our fundamental rights at a moment when there have never been greater threats to both.

New York, NY 10008

body:
The $6 million outside GOP groups have already spent is just the tip of the iceberg.
#

I had a few minutes of free time right now, and it gave me a chance to reflect a bit about this race and what’s at stake for us. I know our campaign sends you a lot of emails, but I wanted to take a moment to send you a note with what’s on my mind — and why your support today is so important to our success.
Truthfully, I knew when we launched that it would not be easy. North Carolina consistently has some of the closest and most expensive Senate races anywhere in the country. And that’s exactly how this race has been shaping up since we clinched the nomination.
The $6 million outside GOP groups have already spent is just the tip of the iceberg. Their smear attacks have only just started, but we haven’t let them go unanswered. Together, we have proven that we are ready to fight for this seat — tirelessly. We won’t ignore the super PACs’ lies or my opponent’s out-of-touch agenda. We’ll take them head-on and make the case to the people of North Carolina that we can win a brighter future where our rights, democracy and planet are protected — and that is what our families deserve.
That’s never been more important than it is right now. As the former Chief Justice of North Carolina, I understand just how much higher the stakes are with our rights at risk - and politicians who seem dead set on rolling them back.
I stand firm in my commitment that, when we win this race together, I will not hesitate to cast the decisive vote to end the filibuster and defend our democracy, planet, voting rights, and reproductive freedom. That is the necessary and just action required to stand up to Washington and create a future where all of our kids have opportunities to thrive.
That is my promise to you, but I cannot do this alone. If we are going to flip this seat and expand our majority, it’s going to take a lot of grassroots support. So before our end-of-month deadline gets here, I need to ask:
[**Can you please add a contribution to our campaign to flip North Carolina and expand our Senate majority? body:
We need climate change action TODAY.

|
---
Derek, It’s hot out there. Virginia’s going through a record heat wave, as is the rest of the globe. There are wildfires in Europe, India had it’s hottest spring on record, London just broke its all-time record temperature, and it was 111 degrees in Oklahoma last week. **[We cannot wait any longer – we need Democrats everywhere to contribute and ensure our elected officials take this climate crisis as seriously as the moment demands.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48295480/357717180/-118115906?refcode=dpva-em-220725-hot&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYWQwYWUyOS01MDBjLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=qtWQ0IdFMI9VpiJYqgSMJs5R-TDg3To5Ty2eTdqHYYA=)** Instead of leading Virginia to the life-threatening changes in climate the whole world is grappling with, Glenn Youngkin is channeling his Texan colleague by burying his head in the sand to the climate realities we are facing. In his first 6 months, he has not only tried to pull Virginia out of the Regional Greenhouse Gas Initiative, but he also nominated Trump’s disastrous EPA Director to be Virginia’s Secretary of Natural Resources. name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: URGENT: Senate voting today on huge corporate welfare bill!
body:
| | |
---
Somehow, Congress is able to take a good concept – the idea that America must compete better with China – and turn it into a terrible bill. **The “CHIPS- Plus” bill that is up for a cloture vote this afternoon at 5:30 pm Eastern is a perfect example.** Instead of shrinking the regulatory regime that makes it so much more expensive to manufacture semiconductor chips in America than in Taiwan, South Korea, and China, Congress chose to do what it does best – spend more money, run up the national debt, and pick winners and losers in the marketplace. **Congress wants to spend $250 billion (that we don’t even have) on a bill full of corporate welfare to bribe companies to manufacture semiconductor chips in America.** **This is a _terrible_ idea!** **This is _not_ how we make America more competitive!** Unfortunately, 16 Republican Senators already voted yes on the motion to proceed – to put the bill on the floor. If those 16 Senators vote yes again today to end debate, this bill is basically a done deal. The Democrats won’t need 16 Republicans to pass it in the end. They will only need 50 Democrats and Kamala Harris to break the tie. **Today’s cloture vote is THE vote we need to affect! It is of vital importance that you call both of your senators immediately, as soon as you are done reading this email!** You can use the sample script below when you call: _Hello, I am calling today to tell my senator to vote no on the CHIPS-Plus bill cloture vote happening today; it is corporate welfare that picks winners and losers, which is unAmerican and will do nothing to make us more competitive with China in the long run. Instead, my senator should work to shrink the regulatory regime that makes it too expensive to manufacture semiconductor chips in America. Vote NO!_ **This call to action is important for everyone, whether you have a Republican or Democrat senator. And if your senators are any of the following Republicans, you absolutely must call them!**** ** Blunt, Capito, Cassidy, Collins, Cornyn, Daines, Graham, Hagerty, Murkowski, Portman, Romney, Rounds, Sasse, Tillis, Wicker, Young. | | Hi, friend! During the first leg of the election cycle, a lot of our supporters were curious about our TV ad strategy. In fact, one of the biggest questions our team received during the first leg of the sprint was: _Why is there only one Patty ad on TV?_ The answer is actually pretty simple. Running one TV ad _starts_ at about $35,000, and the longer it runs, the more expensive it becomes. Since our goal has always been to win the _general_ election, we wanted to make sure we were using our grassroots dollars as effectively as possible by concentrating our efforts on sending Patty to Congress for a **full term**. clean_body: We're at a defining moment in the fight for reproductive choice. = Hi, did you catch Jen's message from this weekend? We're at a defining moment in the fight for reproductive choice, and it's absolutely critical that Congress move quickly to protect the right to access to contraception – because that right could be next on the chopping block after the Supreme Court's decision to overturn Roe v. Wade. Thank you, Team Jen — Begin Forwarded Message — The House just passed a bill that would federally protect the right to contraception. We must act now to preserve our progress from right-wing attacks. ** When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade last month, we saw that the extremist majority is willing to overlook decades of judicial precedent. That’s why it is more important than ever that Congress protect the rights we have fought for over the past several decades. Far-right Republicans are on a mission to undo social progress across the country, and the decision to overturn Roe was only the beginning. In his concurring opinion for the case that overturned Roe , Justice Clarence Thomas wrote that the Supreme Court ought to revisit landmark cases that protected fundamental rights — including access to contraception. The GOP has moved aggressively to pass their agenda at the state level and within the judicial branch. We have every reason to fear more restrictive legislation here in Georgia should future court rulings further erode our rights. So we need federal action now, and we need to put pressure on the Senate to do its part. Thank you, Jen Jordan | | | Democratic State Senator Jen Jordan (pronounced Jer-Dun) has spent her legal career fighting for Georgians. subject: What matters most to you right now?

body:
https://secure.ngpvan.com/uDj5f4IAKUGSBei00oSbnA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/uDj5f4IAKUGSBei00oSbnA2]
https://secure.ngpvan.com/uDj5f4IAKUGSBei00oSbnA2 [https://secure.ngpvan.com/uDj5f4IAKUGSBei00oSbnA2]
The devastating events of the past few months — from mass shootings in Buffalo, Uvalde, Highland Park, and elsewhere around the country to the overturning of Roe v. Wade — are weighing heavily on Texans and Americans.
Polls show a majority of Texans believe we need stronger gun-safety laws and oppose a total ban on abortion. The majority of Americans feel the same way.
And we know rising prices — at the gas pump and the grocery store — are having real impacts on Texans and people across the country.
Many voters are saying these are among the issues that are important to them going into November’s midterm elections. Today, Lizzie wants to hear which issues are most important to you now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/uDj5f4IAKUGSBei00oSbnA2]
TAKE THE SURVEY [https://secure.ngpvan.com/uDj5f4IAKUGSBei00oSbnA2]
Who we elect in November will determine how we address these issues — or frankly, if we address them at all.
Lizzie’s fighting for smart, thoughtful solutions to the biggest challenges facing our country. She voted to codify Roe, protect access to abortion care, and our right to travel across state lines for that care. She voted for the first federal gun-safety laws in nearly 30 years. And she voted for measures to fix supply chain issues that are driving up prices and to continue building on the record job gains our economy has seen over the past year.
Your vote matters, your opinion matters, and your engagement matters. Please take a moment to fill out our survey and share which issues are most important to you right now. [https://secure.ngpvan.com/uDj5f4IAKUGSBei00oSbnA2]
Thanks,
Team Lizzie

| | **JACOBS AND BROWNLEY INVITED TO APPEAR
AT VENTURA COUNTY AGRICULTURAL FORUM** _“Meet The Candidates” forum is first opportunity for candidates to appear jointly_ **Thousand Oaks, CA -** Matt Jacobs, Federal Prosecutor and Republican nominee for U.S.
Congress in California’s 26th District, **will participate in a “Meet The Candidates” forum on**
**August 5th at the Ventura County Fairgrounds hosted by several Ventura County**
**agricultural groups.** This will be the first time both Jacobs and incumbent Democrat Julia
Brownley will have the opportunity to appear jointly and tell CA-26 voters where they stand on
the issues impacting Ventura County’s agricultural community.
_“Agriculture is an essential part of Ventura County’s economy, heritage, and way of life. After all,_
_this county was founded on agriculture more than 150 years ago. And today, the agricultural_
_industry contributes billions of dollars to our economy while employing tens of thousands of_
_Ventura County residents,”_**Jacobs said.**
_“This forum will give voters their first opportunity to see us both on the same stage. I look_
_forward to contrasting my commonsense approach to addressing the issues confronting our_
_agricultural community with Rep. Brownley’s record of failure and neglect._
_“Julia Brownley’s votes in Congress have led to rampant inflation, record-high gas and food_
_prices, the release of violent criminals, and dismal educational outcomes for so many children._
_When it comes to agricultural issues, her extreme positions have done grave damage to local_
_farmers and ranchers._
_“I’m grateful to Ventura County CoLAB, the Farm Bureau of Ventura County, the Ventura_
_County Agricultural Association, the Ventura County Cattlemen’s Association, and the California_
_Women for Agriculture Ventura County Chapter for giving CA-26 voters the opportunity to hear_
_from both candidates in a neutral, non-partisan forum so that they can decide for themselves_
_who will best serve Ventura County’s agricultural community in Congress.”_ **###** About Matt Jacobs - Born and raised in Ventura County, Matt Jacobs devoted his career to
serving our country and keeping our community safe. As a federal prosecutor, Matt took on our
country’s worst enemies – terrorists, child sex traffickers, fentanyl dealers – and won. Now
Matt’s running for Congress to get our country back on track by taking on the out-of-touch
politicians who’ve failed us. // Learn more about Matt here: [“Defending the American Dream.”](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=6ff4f6f84fb54fc2b2c965d97606c8a9&_e=kJ6em6o9cJYphDdHs2EgkNSapX4kxTdXpqZiIrF172csvk362vjrPgoUAg9jH88iDLU0jHz1klxq-1EnSw_UZu8WXPh0LTrsNZi89YIvPbxES-IyzSHwa-PacrkYDOJoeZOl3bxOVFaYeeox5xNPkeWMThghd6PbJFqwQXgX55EKpxVk8Wh77BIEBx1G9R6cUCOdmtneAG25aLgUc4Ub-jPzWCwD_2TvtSFr7Mfcq7fgBZ7STJH2fOSQ6Y8Z_HEmiAKB97rSQJCnONEskXsRRNkm0q_NdefX8cAfXk6jutc%3D)

| | “It would misunderstand these men and women to say they disrespect the idea of marriage. Their plea is that they do respect it, respect it so deeply that they seek to find its fulfillment for themselves.” - Justice Anthony Kennedy, _Obergefell v. Hodges_ Folks — This past Tuesday, I voted to pass the Respect for Marriage Act in the House. This bill aims to recognize same-sex marriage under federal law – a long overdue act. This vote was as joyous of a moment as it was sobering for me. The reality is, the freedom to marry who you love is in question as the far-right conservatives on the Supreme Court could overturn _Obergefell v. Hodges_ next. In his opinion, Justice Clarence Thomas outlined his game plan to take down some of the most sacred Supreme Court decisions – including _Obergefell_ – that were decided on the right to privacy. To do so would not merely be immoral but also downright reprehensible. For me, it’s simple: **love should always be celebrated and protected.** Marriage is one of the oldest institutions that humans have taken part in as an act of unity and love towards one another. I’ve always considered myself a strong LGBTQ+ ally and that stands true today. As long as I’m in Congress, Nevadans can rest assured that I’ll fight like hell to protect their right to marry. I’m urging Republicans in the Senate to vote in favor of the Respect for Marriage Act which will recognize same-sex marriage under federal law. It’s time that we make this right official and stand with our LGBTQ+ brothers and sisters who make our country great. I hope you’ll stand with me in this important fight. In unity, Susie Lee P.S. – Protecting the rights of every Nevadan has always been my top priority in Congress. This year, I’m up for re-election and am facing my toughest challenge yet. [1]Stacey Abrams for Governor

Derek,

July 31 will mark 100 days until Election
Day. That’s why today, we’re launching our 100 Days Fund — and we’ve set
the ambitious goal to raise $1 million by July 31!

Hitting our goal in just seven short days will show everyone just how
strong and energized our team is. However, if we fall short, it will
signal to Brian Kemp, national Republicans and everyone else that our
momentum is slowing down.

We can hit our $1 million goal, but we’re going to need all hands on deck
to reach it by July 31.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220725_B1_1MillLaunch_S1_T1_HQ_30op&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1002&akid=1143%2E1862389%2EgGhvk3 ]We hope we can count on you,
Derek. Will you help fill our
100 Days Fund with a $5 contribution now? This $1 million
goal may seem daunting, but if everyone reading this — including you —
chips in now we’ll hit it by our July 31 goal.

Please understand: we’re not making up the $1 million number — it is
precisely what we need to raise in order to hire staff, train volunteers,
invest in ads on every platform, mobilize voters and everything else we
need to do to win in the final 100 days of this campaign.

You’ll hear more from us as we get closer to our July 31st deadline. But
for now, we want to leave you with this, a reminder of the people we are
fighting for:

We’re fighting for a single parent in Commerce
A woman seeking an abortion in Dublin
A small business owner in Decatur
A health care provider in Macon
A teacher in Quitman
And you.

Derek, Stacey
is in this race to create a stronger Georgia for everyone. And we’re
counting on grassroots
supporters like you
to make clear that we have what it takes to win, with just over 100 days
left to go.

[ https://act.staceyabrams.com/go/1490?refcode=sa_em_220725_B1_1MillLaunch_S1_T1_HQ_30op&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&zip=&firstname=Derek&lastname=Willis&addr1=&city=&state=&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&amount=5&amounts=5%2C25%2C50%2C100%2C250&t=1003&akid=1143%2E1862389%2EgGhvk3 ]Please, will you make your
first contribution
right now? Anything you can invest in the 100 Days Fund will be
indispensable to our campaign.

Derek, let’s
get it done.

Stacey Abrams HQ

body:

It's happening, Friend.
First, Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump succeeded in installing Supreme Court justices who overturned _Roe v. Wade_ - ending abortion care for more than 30 million Americans across dozens of states. Now, the GOP is going even further with its agenda, attempting to prosecute those who travel to seek an abortion. They are trying to limit our right to travel freely within our own country.
Worse still, Republicans in Washington are gearing up for a national abortion ban - and they are banking on taking back majorities in Congress to do it. Legislation has already been drawn up in the House of Representatives, and Mitch McConnell says a national ban is on the table if the GOP retakes the Senate. If he has the majority by just one vote, he will abolish the filibuster and move forward. Then all bets are off.
The Republican Party's hypocrisy on this matter is _sickening_. On the one hand, they are legislating control over women's bodies because they claim they are pro "life", while they simultaneously enable the slaughter of innocents because they are more devoted to the ideology that __anyone__ should have access to weapons of war like assault rifles than they actually are to protecting life.
Today's GOP is soulless and lost, and they cannot be allowed to retake control in Washington. **That 's why it's critical we continue to show that the majority of Americans stand against their dangerous agenda. So, I have an important request:**
**[Will you add your name to my urgent petition right now to CONDEMN the policy of a national abortion ban? I'm counting on you to take action that will show the Republican Party we won't stand for their attacks on reproductive freedom.](https://petitions.signforgood.com/blumenthal-july-national-abortion-ban-petition?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&ask=5&amounts=5,25,50,100,250,500&code=jtk1218-su-nd&redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fsurveys.signforgood.com%2Fblumenthal-july-national-abortion-ban-petition)**

I want you to know that I'm fighting with all the power I have in the Senate to stop Republican attacks on women's bodily autonomy. In fact, I've helped introduce legislation that will use the power of the federal government to preempt any state law designed to punish those seeking abortion care across state lines. I will also continue the fight - with many other like-minded colleagues - to increase safety in our nation by diminishing gun violence through common sense legislation.
We simply cannot sit on our hands as the GOP unleashes a dystopian, anti-women, anti-life agenda that the vast majority of Americans don't support. Their attacks on our fundamental civil and human rights are more in line with the work of autocratic dictators than our democratic republic.

clean_body: It's happening, Friend. First, Mitch McConnell and Donald Trump succeeded in installing Supreme Court justices who overturned Roe v. Wade - ending abortion care for more than 30 million Americans across dozens of states. Now, the GOP is going even further with its agenda, attempting to prosecute those who travel to seek an abortion. They are trying to limit our right to travel freely within our own country. Worse still, Republicans in Washington are gearing up for a national abortion ban - and they are banking on taking back majorities in Congress to do it. Legislation has already been drawn up in the House of Representatives, and Mitch McConnell says a national ban is on the table if the GOP retakes the Senate. If he has the majority by just one vote, he will abolish the filibuster and move forward. Then all bets are off. The Republican Party's hypocrisy on this matter is sickening. On the one hand, they are legislating control over women's bodies because they claim they are pro "life", while they simultaneously enable the slaughter of innocents because they are more devoted to the ideology that anyone should have access to weapons of war like assault rifles than they actually are to protecting life. Today's GOP is soulless and lost, and they cannot be allowed to retake control in Washington. That 's why it's critical we continue to show that the majority of Americans stand against their dangerous agenda. So, I have an important request: I want you to know that I'm fighting with all the power I have in the Senate to stop Republican attacks on women's bodily autonomy. In fact, I've helped introduce legislation that will use the power of the federal government to preempt any state law designed to punish those seeking abortion care across state lines. I will also continue the fight - with many other like-minded colleagues - to increase safety in our nation by diminishing gun violence through common sense legislation. We simply cannot sit on our hands as the GOP unleashes a dystopian, anti-women, anti-life agenda that the vast majority of Americans don't support. Their attacks on our fundamental civil and human rights are more in line with the work of autocratic dictators than our democratic republic. So I'm urging you, Friend: Thank you very much for using your voice in this critical fight. Dick

body:
[](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=24a080f94ee04fb28033fec69135e8e6&_e=_B7HxsEPw6BnnOlXk5L7_GG6fv1pcRSi7FwD10no1VC7o1OeEQLgFnb6XzIy1FW5f-cTdrCgyBc0G1e2xsB_4OKUT5nXzyLS853ApOD6WJRutjYsbz3MoJGbMLXZy-ak-vF2nGqV2JS0qzjZgKaInhpz9l9ZizNm-bLpw_y5OX6982L5HnvwxQduR_KUAfTuWxUlXUx90N-LMoZ85H1lL5B0LYCMFodxO7bdGgDqc9CN57z-KpGoFQLmpHv9UNFlIwk8t8kxwPw-uU_89qEJeCMLGCzIH0eoHqCcGB59AkVGxcKvrsY5peBH__rkFMP_wgrM2wrkB0OJLahCNKPvVB4u4yFOFUW570-AtbErxXU%3D)

Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

Derek, It’s the end of July, and election season is in full swing. We’ve got a lot of crucial races in Virginia this year, and once again the eyes of the nation are on the Commonwealth. Control over the U.S. House hangs in the balance, and will come down to a few critical seats here at home. Reps. Elaine Luria, Abigail Spanberger, and Jennifer Wexton are in the middle of tough races, and the need for us to send them back to Washington for another term continues to grow with every passing day. **[Will you help me send our three outstanding congresswomen back to Washington this November?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48308941/357735824/-118115906?refcode=dpva-em-220725-swecker&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84NDIzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIyMzZkYzJkNi01ZTBjLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=UCtaVml059_FZOUR66o3YMK8MpmpSdd8nvI_radA-6g=)** We’ve said it a lot over the past month, but it bears repeating: after the overturn of _Roe v. Wade_ , so many of our rights appear to be on the chopping block. It’s no longer just about abortion, but now the GOP has taken aim at access to contraception and the freedom for consenting adults to marry the ones they love. It feels like we learn something new from the January 6th Committee every day. If Trump’s lapdog Kevin McCarthy is in charge of the House, we know he’ll shut down their investigation into the insurrection before jetting off to Mar-A-Lago to tell his boss. We can’t let that happen. These rights that we hold sacred are the GOP’s target. We know this, because they tell us, time and time again. We need to listen. The staff and I at the Democratic Party of Virginia are working tirelessly to ensure that all Virginians’ personal freedoms are protected, but we can’t do it alone. The GOP is working overtime to continue turning back the clock on our progress. **[That’s why I’m asking you to join me in this fight, Derek. Friend,

**I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -_Black Lives Matter_.**

Now, I know what you’re thinking... _What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis?_

I ask, “what about them is influential?!”

This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities?

No. They aren’t, but BLM is.

BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations.

I saw the hypocrisy long ago. **That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. **

**BLEXIT** is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities.

_Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture_.

I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support.

[_**Can you please support BLEXIT by sending a gift of $5, $10, $20.22, $100, or any amount you can afford today? Click here to donate >>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7b8be88ef33f45abb3636335af44b4fc&_e=mA6dKMo4Y9WMuKz61qayBoxy0Rrh1E14qlZDrrmVeI9eaFtlvQW-fpVsmkUYF1j6tIBTCjot-TaFsdKaXxhPHlph-rfzTTqNupniiDRPK_eYPobTkpwFpzqPPVMkoxpr0L0r2eICELSFfDGY1KRa2uago_JIrRqIaCC0bKqH1SiGJaFu2PLhb90a0P_UpEl45gjDnNJ9um2Dm4avoPur7yvjXLOvSx8m_nuyF_Z0pALagU6GrMZpgPABJXQoZtyqBNudTQmc1l4gZebd-WtyIff8wcQa1-HUfrFyrr4IcnZD0BAWGaHhdoIDDYJXgP5-xUAP2JlTPtYqUByV_Ry3sLbmgSue-hTE84aO-4UgICg%3D)

**How I Started BLEXIT**

I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans.

With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me.

This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever.

I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM.

Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others.

Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes.

[_**Can you help me reach Black neighborhoods with a message of individualism, freedom, and entrepreneurship? Click here to donate any amount >>**_](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=7b8be88ef33f45abb3636335af44b4fc&_e=mA6dKMo4Y9WMuKz61qayBoxy0Rrh1E14qlZDrrmVeI9eaFtlvQW-fpVsmkUYF1j6tIBTCjot-TaFsdKaXxhPHlph-rfzTTqNupniiDRPK_eYPobTkpwFpzqPPVMkoxpr0L0r2eICELSFfDGY1KRa2mWX34HjN0XPHNkYNszLbz5zCMp6novFBkD_oer802XHmpfRtPlcw6hBrNNZ1J_VWblVPhRNKRVpSlw1C4GYGnB_-8TUE8wzoNR-QMnZKxUexUmGdwF35DGsB_7adzMqGB0mMtW66_bzGaBMiHCJfuNIJiaxO1NXccepVzqNtWOZ7TC2Z_LtvdSBZ2BqPWrSf1WWGwSOXlsEAnHuSO4h4I8%3D)

BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law.

BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them.

BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character.

BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family.

_Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters._

**Here’s how you can help:**

_I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities_.

This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter.

BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members.

clean_body: Friend, I am a Black man, and I’m telling you exactly which organization is the most hateful, divisive group in the United States of America -Black Lives Matter. Now, I know what you’re thinking... What about the KKK, or what about neo-nazis? I ask, “what about them is influential?!” This is 2022. Does the KKK have institutional power like BLM does? Is the KKK receiving millions of dollars from corporations and Hollywood celebrities? No. They aren’t, but BLM is. BLM claims to speak for Black communities. But all I ever hear from BLM is how much they hate America. They only focus on victimhood to divide us as the greatest nation on Earth. BLM cries out for action, but the only action they do is burn down Black neighborhoods and cozy up to corporations. I saw the hypocrisy long ago. That’s why I started the BLEXIT Foundation with Candace Owens. BLEXIT is a non-profit bringing traditional American principles and a message of empowerment to urban minority communities. Our message to America’s black and minority communities is that you are NOT a victim. We promote economic independence and individual freedom, strengthening the nuclear family and fostering a deeper appreciation for patriotism in Black American culture. I believe God has put me on this mission to reach Black communities. I’ll tell you the full story of how I cofounded BLEXIT with Candace, but first, I must ask for your immediate support. How I Started BLEXIT I was an All-American high school football player in Fort Worth, Texas. I accepted a full athletic scholarship from the University of Arizona in 2005. I played at Arizona for five years and entered the NFL Draft in 2010; however, God had other plans. With my entire family around, I was not drafted. I was so angry. I ripped my shirt off. But, God had other plans for me. This led me to join the Tucson police force, and it changed my life forever. I learned what it meant to put my life on the line to save others. I woke up every morning to thank Jesus that I got to live another day to serve. This experience taught me a lot, but it was foundational to learning about the lies of BLM. Learning that BLM is lying to Black communities and teaching them to hate the police forever changed my opinion on the “Black Lives Matter” organization. But more importantly, I learned not to be a victim. Not getting drafted into the NFL taught me life lessons I wouldn’t have learned otherwise. I learned to serve others. Now, I’m giving back to the Black community to make sure they don’t become bought into this toxic victimhood mentality that BLM pushes. BLM incites lawlessness. BLEXIT stands for the rule of law. BLM destroys communities. BLEXIT empowers them. BLM only sees the color of your skin. BLEXIT sees character. BLM wants to disrupt families. BLEXT values the nuclear family. Since our start in 2019, BLEXIT has grown substantially with 42 grassroots chapter programs in 42 states, over 14,000 volunteer members and local community leaders, and nearly 60,000 grassroots supporters. Here’s how you can help: I am looking to raise $83,000 online to support BLEXIT during this critical year. We must expand our chapters, build new leaders, and reach people within Black communities. This is a long game we are playing. If this were a football game, we would only be in the 1st quarter. BLM thinks they speak for Black communities, but we are taking over quickly and providing real opportunities for our members. Friend, I am asking you to join the BLEXIT Foundation by making an investment in our organization. Please use one of the links I’ve copied below to donate today: HOW BLEXIT Works Step One: We enter communities no one else dares to go into - Detroit, Baltimore, New Orleans, Houston, etc. We host events and set up chapters of volunteers who build a support network and help get our message of individualism and empowerment to Black neighborhoods. Step Two: We send the best volunteers and chapter members to our Leadership Academy. We build leaders from the ground up. In fact, our staff is full of stories of activists we hired from the Leadership Academy. They started as a chapter member and now work for us full time. Other members graduate from the Leadership Academy, and then they go back into their communities to support others or start their own businesses. As you can see, we are BUILDING neighborhoods, NOT destroying them. Step Three: Our educational content, both online and in-person, is teaching Black communities ideas they will never hear in the mainstream media. BLEXIT is teaching about individualism, pro-life, school choice, teaching REAL history (not Critical Race Theory), and creating patriotism among Black families. Step Four: We host large events with hundreds, sometimes thousands of attendees. Our events bring music, live entertainment, and education to Black communities. What I really want to emphasize is this - BLEXIT is a “DO” tank! We are out there meeting people in neighborhoods. Friend, this is deeply personal for me as a Black man. We have to save our communities. We must save our country from the toxic and divisive organizations like BLM that are tearing down our businesses and livelihoods. So, please, I implore you to send any amount you generously can. We are a 501(c)(3) organization, and your support is tax-deductible. clean_body: If you’re in this fight with us, if you’re passionate about making this a country where everyone can thrive and electing champions who work for the people, there’s a reason why. | | | Peter, There’s a powerful tool in politics, one that you might not be using. It doesn’t cost anything, it can be used anywhere, and it’s accessible to anyone, no matter their age, gender, race, or background. That tool is your story. This Wednesday, July 27 at 7:30 PM ET/4:30 PM PT, we’re hosting a WFP Skills Training: Safety and Story in This Moment. This free, virtual training will help you turn your life experiences into a quick story that can change minds, build connections, and strengthen our movement. Whether you’re meeting a voter, reconnecting with an old friend, or spending time with family, personal stories build bridges between people. They allow you to cut through partisan bias and stubbornness to show the true human impact of the policies we’re fighting for. If you’re in this fight with us, if you’re passionate about making this a country where everyone can thrive and electing champions who work for the people, there’s a reason why. It can be easy to discount your own story as boring or ordinary because, well, it happened to you. But we promise: Your story is compelling. It’s relatable and it’s motivating. Yes, yours, Peter. Your story can be a formidable force for good. You just have to know how to use it. Peter,

Thirty-two years ago tomorrow, the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) was signed into law. This landmark legislation provided protections to those living with disabilities and was a step forward to ensuring our workplaces, businesses, and transportation were accessible to all.

Representative Jim Langevin has been a fierce advocate for people with disabilities. As the first and only quadriplegic to serve in Congress, Congressman Langvein founded the Bipartisan Disabilities Caucus and helped pass legislation to strengthen protections for people with disabilities.

We've made a lot of progress since the ADA was passed but still have a lot of work to build on what Representative Langevin and other leaders have accomplished. Even with the protections provided in the ADA, millions of Americans still struggle to be included in many aspects of society.

As Treasurer, Seth was proud to join with other state treasurers, legislators, and members of Congress to implement the Access to a Better Life Experience Act. This bill gives those living with disabilities and their families a way to save for the future without sacrificing the federal benefits upon which they rely.

Seth knows how important it is that Rhode Island businesses, workplaces, housing, and transportation are accessible for all. That's why in Congress, he will continue working to ensure all Americans living with disabilities are protected and included in their communities.

This landmark legislation provided protections to those living with disabilities and was a step forward to ensuring our workplaces, businesses, and transportation were accessible to all. Peter, Thirty-two years ago tomorrow, the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) was signed into law. This landmark legislation provided protections to those living with disabilities and was a step forward to ensuring our workplaces, businesses, and transportation were accessible to all. Representative Jim Langevin has been a fierce advocate for people with disabilities. As the first and only quadriplegic to serve in Congress, Congressman Langvein founded the Bipartisan Disabilities Caucus and helped pass legislation to strengthen protections for people with disabilities. We've made a lot of progress since the ADA was passed but still have a lot of work to build on what Representative Langevin and other leaders have accomplished. Even with the protections provided in the ADA, millions of Americans still struggle to be included in many aspects of society. As Treasurer, Seth was proud to join with other state treasurers, legislators, and members of Congress to implement the Access to a Better Life Experience Act. This bill gives those living with disabilities and their families a way to save for the future without sacrificing the federal benefits upon which they rely. Seth knows how important it is that Rhode Island businesses, workplaces, housing, and transportation are accessible for all. That's why in Congress, he will continue working to ensure all Americans living with disabilities are protected and included in their communities. Thanks, Team Seth Seth Magaziner is a father, husband, and proud Democrat. He’s running for Congress to fight for the middle class and those working hard to join it. Seth will protect Social Security and Medicare and work to lower the cost of prescription drugs by allowing Medicare to negotiate with drug companies. He will defend a woman’s right to choose, stand up to the gun lobby to pass common sense gun safety measures, and make Rhode Island a leader in the clean energy economy - creating good jobs while combatting the climate crisis. Seth is running for Congress in the competitive open Second District. body:
We have a 50-50 split in the Senate – and three Democratic seats are already rated toss-ups ...
| | |
---
I have 15 minutes of free time this afternoon, friend. It may not sound like much – but I've been working long hours in Congress to pass President Biden's agenda, and a gap in my schedule like this is rare.
So, as I'm sitting with my husband, Jerry, and drinking my coffee, I'm reflecting on this historic campaign – and I've decided I need to tell you a little bit more about my decision to run for U.S. Senate.
Back when I was growing up in Jacksonville, I went to segregated schools, washed dishes and worked at McDonald's. But my mom saw something special in me. She'd tell me I was _destined_ for something bigger.
So, when I thought about 2022 and what our country needed to build back better after a disastrous presidency, I thought about her everlasting words to me: "Never tire, Val." I thought about the hardworking families like mine who deserve a leader who understands their lives, their struggles and their dreams. I thought about our country's need to expand our Democratic Senate majority to protect our democracy. And, in the background of all of this, I heard my mother's voice in my head telling me I could win.
So, I decided to run. And now, a few points from Marco Rubio in a race that can decide Senate control, and the stakes are higher than ever: We have a 50-50 split in the Senate. If we lose just one seat, Mitch McConnell regains Senate control – and three Democratic seats are already rated toss-ups.

It's critical that we win in Florida – and this race is tight right now, friend. I'm proud that our movement has an average donation of just $28.45, but building a people-powered movement means it's going to take all hands on deck to compete against the GOP's millions in dark money already pouring into Florida.
My 15 minutes are almost up, and I have to run to my next call: I hate to ask this, but if you believe in this campaign and want to help me defend our Democratic Senate majority, will you donate $5 today? The FBI launched an inquiry into gain-of-function research at the facility, which received a number of grants from Dr. Anthony Fauci's National Institute of Allergy and Infectious Disease. == The National Law Review Similarly, to AB 979, SB 826 faced opposition from Judicial Watch, a conservative activist group. Judicial Watch sued the secretary of state on behalf of California taxpayers to enjoin enforcement (i.e., prohibit by judicial order) of SB 826, and on May 13, 2022, LASC judge, Judge Duffy-Lewis, held in the group’s favor. body:
When I was starting out as a public defender, running for office was something I never imagined I’d do.
| | | When I was starting out as a public defender, running for office was something I never imagined I’d do.

And early on, there were doubters. When I ran in my first race, my opponent said a young mom couldn't win. So I took my babies door-to-door, talked to as many voters as I could, and ended up winning that race by 30 points.

Now I'm running for U.S. Senate, and outside Republicans are spending $27 million to lie to folks about who I am and what I stand for -- **so I'm humbly turning to you:** **[Will you split a $5 donation between my campaign and the DSCC to help us flip this seat and expand our Senate majority?](https://go.dscc.org/go/7149?amount=5&t=4&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C25%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20220725-CheriBeasley-BeasleyTandemV2PersonalRF-ETG-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20220725-CheriBeasley-BeasleyTandemV2PersonalRF-ETG-sl1&akid=5439%2E9716520%2E1K-0iL)**

I’m running in this race to be a voice for people just like you -- to cast the decisive 51st vote for progress on abortion rights, voting rights, climate action, and more.

The experts say North Carolina is one of Democrats' BEST chances to win that 51st vote... but did I mention those $27 million dollars I'm up against? The truth is I simply cannot do this alone.

**Outside Republicans can try all they want to bully me and buy North Carolina's seat. But I refuse to back down. I will not accept a future where our children have fewer rights than we did. We cannot go backward.**
