body:
This will be the most important race in the entire country...This will be the most important race in the entire country... |
Friend,

Will you help me FIRE Liz Cheney and take back our conservative movement from the elitist establishment that is working arm-in-arm with Joe Biden?

No sooner had President Trump endorsed my primary challenge to Liz Cheney did she shoot back with her usual arrogance to "bring it."

[**Well, I'm counting on you to help me bring it by chipping in with an emergency donation to my campaign to FIRE Liz Cheney.**](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b14ff083685c4d279caa15614aca63f9&_e=SITHzHdppjj_-RafnlmllIfSc8TwtndCN82zSk5gnbbjVp8nRTTI0o5mLfJsN1HcB1ff-QGO3ung-dCHdrY9HOSB_9Ab5z3G5PIRCv16fkhK4E4v7EpoBHgslodGRJ7Mcj492RAwnw7XRyTVcapcq72AWnkSGPae26Usw9baZ1L42Ty7tcZT6r3-e-uSYOFR_rQSr33RdrymqQ0A-fK42roGsBeEgqIhJPdCZQ1jkwjT1_T2dAS4UJJ454rXX6gGKQMo87FP-FvKPme4qPdbR8oNGKYW4E0rXCg8RMB3pOnO4aSh5fiBDkiQMuQgr2kzwJ0I77oUCawIHm-vf4yW7F8-6BXQTwx_xGF9QH8D1CefH26EImXsH0T2lWMTBk3EOSwkyTlA7_NiW_sekMklZYRZZvIUhZ2p1xx8fWLoI4thkttNoI4h-2SAveRnNOcGy__NbRditHYqS6KH_hLvyRVm5Y_pwWQu2LA3jysMDGI%3D) [DONATE NOW](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b14ff083685c4d279caa15614aca63f9&_e=SITHzHdppjj_-RafnlmllIfSc8TwtndCN82zSk5gnbbjVp8nRTTI0o5mLfJsN1HcB1ff-QGO3ung-dCHdrY9HOSB_9Ab5z3G5PIRCv16fkhK4E4v7EpoBHgslodGRJ7Mcj492RAwnw7XRyTVcapcq72AWnkSGPae26Usw9baZ1L42Ty7tcZT6r3-e-uSYOFR_rQSr33RdrymqQ0A-fK42roGsBeEgqIhJPdCZQ1jkwjT1_T2dAS4UJJ454rXX6gGCRuCy74RNd_el0mpd7C-uX5T_euGAXr82zBvGwbA-1oUyA0OY6AwVScOdTt-ND-WAwSTx4EylpjeIJVAbxY7tux2Fs1igiek8_IwMfCWF5A6ceqAcwRjr5prFB_AsDKGBLDF21ZBfk5KLxdeBCIc5ASa-R70io4qBhuvqhAK75boHrDU9Hc4AXxfeTKag52_mqif4fsWZSXw3Tf6lEC60PcvQCmnaVT-MlgenpyT9UU%3D)
You and I don't have a moment to lose...

That's because establishment elitists, like George W. Bush, headline ritzy fundraisers in other states to raise millions for Cheney.

That was even after Cheney admitted in a 60 Minutes interview that her record-breaking fundraising haul was helped out by Democrats.

If there was ever a time for conservative Americans to stand up to the elitist establishment, it's now. And it's against Liz Cheney.

[**Will you help me stand up with an urgently needed donation today?**](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b14ff083685c4d279caa15614aca63f9&_e=SITHzHdppjj_-RafnlmllIfSc8TwtndCN82zSk5gnbbjVp8nRTTI0o5mLfJsN1HcB1ff-QGO3ung-dCHdrY9HOSB_9Ab5z3G5PIRCv16fkhK4E4v7EpoBHgslodGRJ7Mcj492RAwnw7XRyTVcapcq72AWnkSGPae26Usw9baZ1L42Ty7tcZT6r3-e-uSYOFR_rQSr33RdrymqQ0A-fK42roGsBeEgqIhJPdCZQ1jkwjT1_T2dAS4UJJ454rXX6gGwGPNybJguCCNXxTyasAOFIvHqLurLW1UyWp7V8o08l7h-I-cUMJ3bsZPvXlnJT6bEKnqQ0GRGyfHtvweMe15L5TArl9FtBRL8RDJDqBlQCA_PQk5O_rONiVMj1KqoEQk9bgdaCFYOgeGOQVmGovmEWFN_x27ZlrwBAWSfqj-GxP-_cX3vSrA0iULkDg0fJagxYk4ituiWZnJF-fFHwT9uvMb7l1xDu5Kelv3Ucyr5Bc%3D)

I'm getting ahead of myself.

Before you decide to give to my campaign to FIRE establishment-anointed Liz Cheney from Congress, **let me tell you a little about who I am, why President Trump endorsed my primary challenge, and why we need your immediate help.**

My name is Harriet Hageman, and Wyoming is my home.

Growing up on a ranch outside Ft. Laramie, I learned the value of hard work, integrity, self-sufficiency, and honesty from an early age.

They're not just values Joe Biden and his socialists hate – they run absolutely counter to the establishment elites who have for too long controlled our Republican Party... and sold out our country to the highest bidder.

**I should know – like many in my state, and many more around the country, I was duped by these same "Republicans."**

**And as a constitutional lawyer who fought against Bill Clinton's EPA regulations, I watched in disgust as establishment elites like Liz Cheney embraced big government and abandoned our conservative values.**

Unfortunately, it's only gotten worse since President Trump left office.

And now, backed by their friends on the left and the media, Cheney and the establishment are waging a full-blown war on Americans like you and me!

[**No more. Will you support my campaign to defeat Liz Cheney by making an emergency donation today? I'll be honest, her LIBERAL big money backers are putting millions of dollars into her campaign right. Without your help, I don't stand a chance.**](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b14ff083685c4d279caa15614aca63f9&_e=SITHzHdppjj_-RafnlmllIfSc8TwtndCN82zSk5gnbbjVp8nRTTI0o5mLfJsN1HcB1ff-QGO3ung-dCHdrY9HOSB_9Ab5z3G5PIRCv16fkhK4E4v7EpoBHgslodGRJ7Mcj492RAwnw7XRyTVcapcq72AWnkSGPae26Usw9baZ1L42Ty7tcZT6r3-e-uSYOFR_rQSr33RdrymqQ0A-fK42roGsBeEgqIhJPdCZQ1jkwjT1_T2dAS4UJJ454rXX6gGr-sUfzXIzcShiDQRHufKZDUTMF9AwyV5kaYUcH00-hBvuf30vrNvJL5Q8TC98lCU7RhNq-K_AGYSfWxVH8YUWQZjgVjup17h8tJt_GDs0ixMnlqf8onuqxkmRmnNSakiXYxADw-hT322W5XQOfLgSFqLegHQY5HitjpgAG1JM0bDWC6_PGgqxstOpJLrPU7ztDWgOHB3ui9rfy339XhIkPduQ0wPPTSYwGXYpVkWX7o%3D) [DONATE NOW](http://links.defend-the-constitution.org/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=b14ff083685c4d279caa15614aca63f9&_e=SITHzHdppjj_-RafnlmllIfSc8TwtndCN82zSk5gnbbjVp8nRTTI0o5mLfJsN1HcB1ff-QGO3ung-dCHdrY9HOSB_9Ab5z3G5PIRCv16fkhK4E4v7EpoBHgslodGRJ7Mcj492RAwnw7XRyTVcapcq72AWnkSGPae26Usw9baZ1L42Ty7tcZT6r3-e-uSYOFR_rQSr33RdrymqQ0A-fK42roGsBeEgqIhJPdCZQ1jkwjT1_T2dAS4UJJ454rXX6gGTrL088oVEjldoOO8FCZNvJc6C1GEPnLnQ2gUdLGdH5tYsZsPwFU2LVRfiliYijGiRAwdfEJWXiXv18WyyswqxREf-RTyFu6a9gwjCpiouLT6bwdOFGXMHKzxbqZettf-TU8HhMpAt9UN88RgGTk47J9rEv-mlN1dus20ArQjLP4vA4FO22mEyeOzyLb5g44o7wV8eFKFsx785b-enUX028cNLhM7yNdFx2wkMzx8umQ%3D) As I said at the start of this email, **President Trump is 100% behind me.**

He knows the people of Wyoming – and the _American_ people - deserve better than Cheney, and he knows I'll never abandon our conservative values once elected to Congress.

In Wyoming, we have a long and proud history of standing up against an overbearing government.

In Washington, I promise to do the same...

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bf6559c6a94a408497e3a8551f6efcce&_e=QNKfjHouPSzEf68VuYMYOO9RDSuI9teslr81dH2qT2oRKNRAIMaT1oVyP8FQw-JCNc7m7ydj-3TonAUzqidYjl-fuahB0Qbf1Ajvuz77KYpkKNCKq5EaCMaJDwEJ558fX1-ZgcSLPFfLMKc4fo2R8eVQDTIdgVHg5OHneoBf71IFaO7EiNIBmblxx_ZSGK7m4rwvEvV1yxSFqlFREvjdxcG_gHlicloD1xch1t-ENriglOCsQo8pWcZ1m-iXK3ezonV5afonZaq07Afir3ZtDQ0u4Kf-dAgPwtt6uunkSm4SkWTcnM2pCqV0l2KxoAcddfoeviJXOI0l90N0odQDvbTcWaaYWOrL3Ox-ba67fuMtLXH9lzNArYSm1OLV97ILDpb3Ix5UC4l7PsPO4sUKSC9YuO_2fsgDw7KNFW6gNKrY_-x1_CW5oqEWHN5w9dhW-1yRtqudAQRYOkJd0ha_qyN0ZdZE9vcm72GGf_sJJZQ%3D)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.conservativesgive.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=bf6559c6a94a408497e3a8551f6efcce&_e=QNKfjHouPSzEf68VuYMYOO9RDSuI9teslr81dH2qT2oRKNRAIMaT1oVyP8FQw-JCNc7m7ydj-3TonAUzqidYjl-fuahB0Qbf1Ajvuz77KYpkKNCKq5EaCMaJDwEJ558fX1-ZgcSLPFfLMKc4fo2R8eVQDTIdgVHg5OHneoBf71IFaO7EiNIBmblxx_ZSGK7m4rwvEvV1yxSFqlFREvjdxcG_gHlicloD1xch1t-ENriglOCsQo8pWcZ1m-iXK3ez8tCyNwv0v3f1OEKv82UReYKmWsTFGAFsAPLxB2CcsVX8pUDl68zaDzPsE64vQDtqXr9wR4lbC6vDUjjy9rfkPjhEAjRXa9kgeymF5owFkZGB3VmwAikel5gdaFmoZODUDiX8gtmCHSsCLBN_JSjiUSOYYcapkwNNNFW9pnsvft47f7y5M2tIEAEjlBWw2AzlOcnWbdfw2NbVWI34YPaFhTN9gFweQ4V7PldKPzF-BIQ%3D)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

Peter, this month, Joe Manchin killed negotiations on Build Back Better – yet again – tanking any chance that Democrats have of passing big climate change legislation. **But he couldn’t have done it without Sinema’s help.**
It’s not getting as much attention right now, but **Kyrsten Sinema’s opposition to even small changes to Trump’s ludicrously low corporate tax scheme** means that Democrats are left with barely any options to fund urgently-needed climate and social legislation. (And no options that Joe Manchin will support.) Worse, Sinema refuses to explain to anyone why she opposes corporate tax increases and won’t answer questions or negotiate. name: Greg Stamps
subject: The history of capitalism and socialism
body:
| | Please see a special message from our sponsor.
---
| | | | [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.)
---
| | Dear Friend, Over the last century, free-market capitalism and socialism have provided the dominant interpretations, and conflicting visions, of political and economic freedom. In the past few years, we've seen a growing trend among young Americans in favor of socialism and against capitalism.
---
| [](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._lnwUHHhvfw)
---
| | **But do they truly understand the history and outcomes of socialism and capitalism?** This is _precisely_ why we put together this brand new eBook, **[_The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.-jql_8fW8V2zs54_w)**[](http://trk.freedomfirstproject.), from Hoover Institution senior fellows Niall Ferguson and Victor Davis Hanson. This eBook consists of two papers-one from each scholar-written in conjunction with _The Human Prosperity Project on Socialism and Free-Market Capitalism_. This project provides objective and scholarly analyses of free-market capitalism, socialism, and hybrid systems and provides evidence on the effectiveness of the various systems on outcomes that affect prosperity and well-being. I think you will find this new eBook particularly important and timely, given the recent interest in policies that are radical from a US historical perspective, some of which are advocated by political leaders. **[Simply click here to request your free copy of _The History Of Socialism And Capitalism_.](http://trk.freedomfirstproject._SfQKKEwagQ)** Thanks, Greg Greg Stamps | Online Development Hoover Institution | Stanford University
---

Over more than one hundred years, Hoover's work has directly led to policies that have produced greater freedom, democracy, and opportunity in the United States and around the world._

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---

---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zle4njd3solnfvguq0eipef7g2ov9n0qu79osmko_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stgeeo36chh2bs)
---

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z27hs8ojq2p5lnt6l3ki94nht5fcj8p9n6i0696g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stgeeo36chh2bs)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z13t37tc5o9tvt5ipvu3b2ifdndddik3b67vifo0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stgeeo36chh2bs)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zuab1tcnoa17eqfreljfd3r4jvmp3vdg18bn7038_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stgeeo36chh2bs)
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2zerv5rd0lmvaprlvjcmjlgmk3cvqrjn2910bir8o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stgeeo36chh2bs)**
---

---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---

---
| [](http://e.goppresidential.com/rd/9z2z1gov54cho248sbav5ijed7ko3rbmg8f4qfn8elo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stgeeo36chh2bs)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

subject: I signed a bill allowing 40 million Californians to sue those spreading illegal assault weapons and ghost guns in our state.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY NEWSOM FOR CALIFORNIA – GOVERNOR – 2022
body:
This is the legislation modeled after Texas’ perverse anti-abortion law.

Friends -
Late last week, I signed a bill allowing 40 million Californians to sue those spreading illegal assault weapons and ghost guns in our state.
This is the legislation modeled after Texas’ perverse anti-abortion law. Because if states like Texas can use laws to put women in harm’s way, then California will use that authority to save lives.
Now, some have said, you criticized the Supreme Court’s decision on SB8, the anti-abortion law in Texas. Shouldn’t we be going high when they go low?
It’s a fair question, but it’s not the world we’re living in right now.
We’ve been on the receiving end of Republicans going low time and time again, and we’re not winning.
The Republican Party and the Supreme Court opened this door.
We’re walking through it.
This law means you cannot sell, manufacture, or transfer these weapons of war in California.
And if you do, there are 40 million people who can collect $10,000 plus attorney’s fees.
The passage of this bill was by no means guaranteed.
It took hard work in the legislature.
It took your voices.
But we got it done.
Thank you.
All my best,
Gavin Newsom

| | | **Tanya For Arizona Campaign Round-Up**
**8 DAYS UNTIL PRIMARY DAY!!** Make sure to get your early ballot in or vote in person on August 2nd!

**Still not sure which congressional district you are in?** [Here](https://tanyaforarizona.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=e27b684e0e86fe5dbc580daeb&id=def223d809&e=bd2b55b0e3) is a handy tool: enter your street address and it will give you the answer. Voila! If it’s Congressional District 4, remember to **Vote for Tanya**!

This week **Tanya was endorsed by Former U.S. Congressman Barry Goldwater Jr.** who said Tanya has his "full endorsement to represent Arizona Congressional District 4"

With only days until the primary,**Tanya is laser-focused on connecting with voters, **including** ** spending hours doors (even in 114 degree heat!), phone banking, and attending meet and greets throughout the district.

Tanya can't wait to see you on the trail!

If you want Team Tanya to stop by your group next time or you are interested in volunteering, email us at [info@tanyaforarizona.com](mailto:info@tanyaforarizona.com "mailto:info@tanyaforarizona.com")

With only 8 days to go, we need your help to flip AZ-04! The Democrats are gearing up and prepared to send money and influence into our district to try to hold this seat. We need to show them that we mean business.

We have a lot of opportunities to volunteer whether you have 30 min or a couple of hours.

🤝 Host a meet and greet --> Reply to this email or reach out to Katie at katie@tanyaforarizona.com.

💻 Post on social media and tell your friends why you are supporting Tanya (Remember to tag @tanyaforarizona)

**🚨** **Calling All of Our Team Tanya Social Media Warriors ****🚨**

We need your help to get Tanya's message out to primary voters. Tanya is the only one who can beat Pelosi-Endorsed Democrat Greg Stanton next year and we need to make sure she wins in a landslide on August 2nd.

There are **TWO** ways you can help:

**1.)** Change your profile picture to this Vote Tanya button and leave it up until August 2nd so all of your friends know to get out and vote for Tanya.

body:
---
| | Dear Team:

I have spent the last twenty-one months and two days doing all I can to beat Ron Johnson. He is an embarrassing, unmitigated disaster for our beloved Badger State.

Today I am announcing my support for Mandela Barnes for our party's nomination for US Senate.

With two weeks to go, it is clear there is no path forward for us and we must face these facts. Indeed, a sad refrain we hear too many times in politics is true for this campaign: money matters way too much in politics. Running against two self-funding millionaires proved too much for this pastor's kid.

**I am proud of the race we ran and the ideas we put forward like a national industrial strategy to build good paying jobs in our communities, Medicare for All to ensure everyone has access to health care, a one-of-a-kind food sovereignty plan to lift up our family farmers, bust up Big Ag and help consumers, and a Green New Deal so our children and their children have a planet to live on.**

Unlike billionaire son-in-law Ron Johnson and our millionaire Democratic primary opponents, Mandela Barnes knows firsthand what it's like for families struggling with inflation, without health insurance or a lack of gainful work. He is a good man with a strong progressive record and will serve us well in Washington.

I want to be clear, we are not giving up. We are putting our campaign behind Mandela's to give him the resources for a strong first place finish in the primary and set us up for victory in November.

I am reminded of the Lutheran hymn we sing often at church: "Bind us together with chords that cannot be broken." This campaign has never been about me — it has been about you and finishing off Ron Johnson's career in the Senate, something that can only be done together. Mandela can now count on me to be on his side every step of the way. I hope he can count on your support, too.

Running for office is a difficult, and expensive endeavor, and so much of the work relies on our incredible, enthusiastic staff who have stepped up every step of the way. As we wind down our campaign, my duty to them is to ask you one final time: [can you make a final contribution to our campaign to help pay our final bills as we shift to supporting Mandela and beating Ron Johnson once and for all?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/48313011/357747998/904676731?amount=10&refcode=TN_EM_FR_3MO_220725_2_2&refcode2=6e52cb33-6c0c-ed11-b47a-281878b83d8a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDYvMS84Njk2MCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2ZTUyY2IzMy02YzBjLWVkMTEtYjQ3YS0yODE4NzhiODNkOGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=HG9PxJ8SLNi2UtarATcxrDzNw3xkRbBtaNYsMX_A9-c=)

Thank you for all your support throughout this campaign,

Tom Nelson

clean_body: | | Dear Team: I have spent the last twenty-one months and two days doing all I can to beat Ron Johnson. He is an embarrassing, unmitigated disaster for our beloved Badger State. Today I am announcing my support for Mandela Barnes for our party's nomination for US Senate. With two weeks to go, it is clear there is no path forward for us and we must face these facts. Running against two self-funding millionaires proved too much for this pastor's kid. I am proud of the race we ran and the ideas we put forward like a national industrial strategy to build good paying jobs in our communities, Medicare for All to ensure everyone has access to health care, a one-of-a-kind food sovereignty plan to lift up our family farmers, bust up Big Ag and help consumers, and a Green New Deal so our children and their children have a planet to live on. Unlike billionaire son-in-law Ron Johnson and our millionaire Democratic primary opponents, Mandela Barnes knows firsthand what it's like for families struggling with inflation, without health insurance or a lack of gainful work. body:
Rep. Elaine Luria v. Jen Kiggans

|
---
Derek, Rep. Elaine Luria, a 20-year Navy veteran and small business owner, is up for re-election this year. After two decades serving her country in uniform, she’s served as our Congresswoman from Virginia’s 2nd district since 2019. During this time, she’s been a passionate advocate for workers across the Commonwealth and an ardent defender of our national security, proposing modernizations to protect us from cyberattacks abroad, while serving on the Select Committee to investigate the January 6 insurrection at the U.S. Capitol, protecting us from domestic threats. Meanwhile, Jen Kiggans has refused to say whether or not Joe Biden won the 2020 election, supported the Supreme Court decision overturning Roe, and introduced a dog-whistle “divisive concepts” bill in this year’s General Assembly session. She places her own political aspirations above all else – even if that means denying the results of a free and fair election. **[We’re asking Virginians to take our straw poll: if you could vote for Rep. name: Marco Rubio
subject: Humbly asking you to read this
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Marco Rubio for Senate
body:
I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out.
[View this message in your browser](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z0bmlei8f2pimj7lsj7dv9m3l6or5b3p6c5t2at0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq2sjlemo72sjk6ipr7d9neppqcdtlmui34thgmipnadt4sbp65tpgsspb6plksor64phim5ojctj16op61dhge1jjatb4mkqr2d5l6irj4o9hmho6fkjge9h6cs5icpoe9cr3c1p30pjheiqj0ptmchj39o5icpge1db3c3gbac9hmkorash5u)

|
---
| | | Friend,

I'd like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I've been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I'd take a second to walk you through why I'm running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zad1ip24rt96nv4ub1tfp2tm3pm1t2eed74herjo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zibiib7kuul50esqte1cbpl7v34b3qfp8ukjg6q0_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2z3saqgg5aos1f7ukb4frg9vucklk501icbbjal7g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden's policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that's exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I'm teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zpl1k6o8q95elapagebgppmvqoiecn1nrqlmi8mg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn't have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zvhb67ne5sjd2m8k2hr234u23uaebnnice4qdsvg_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)
---

This brings me to my main point: I'm running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we 're outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you'll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zt0tvft7sqrgjtitnaia3o9gg6oqc0gvqb91bb18_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)**
---
| | | [I'LL JOIN YOU, MARCO!](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zmalkra8mrjo05cuddfff9ksih3l7uctu18p1nbo_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)
---
Thank you so much for taking the time to read this,

Marco Rubio
---
| | | | |
* * *
---
| [](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zlplckkj3b50ea220j5qcavjsl0mc8e6trq44i4g_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)
---
I talk to folks every day who say they haven't donated because they think they need to write a big check or they think my race isn't close.

Well, let me tell you, this race will be decided on a razor-thin margin. Currently, we're only separated by 2%, but considering the MILLIONS my opponent is raising, she could easily take the lead after smearing me in new campaign ads.

With such a tight race, any amount donated today can make a difference.

**[Please, can you give $4, 8, $12.55, or $17 today?](http://e.trumptrainnews.com/rd/9z2zkl5eu7hgionudmuu6t8vlv60rn97el49asvis18_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie0o31c9h2bs)**

| | The closing arguments have been delivered in the _Fair Fight Action v. Raffensperger_ case, drawing the historic trial to an end. We stand with the people of Georgia as we anticipate a ruling in our case ahead of the upcoming November General Election. The _Fair Fight Action v. Raffensperger _trial was the longest running federal voting rights trial in the Eleventh Circuit on record. And since day one, our case has always been about giving Georgia voters the opportunity to have their day in court. We’ve done exactly that: presenting testimony from 50 witnesses including voters and would-be voters, legal experts, and current and former state elections officials. During our trial that stretched over two and a half months, we presented substantial documentary evidence to illustrate the burdens Georgia voters face at every stage of the voting process, and how those burdens result from the suppressive practices of the Georgia Secretary of State and the State Election Board. [_**Your support helps Fair Fight Action hold proponents of anti-voter policies and practices accountable. clean_body: The Fair Fight Action team will continue fighting to protect the freedom to vote for all Georgians: Fair Fight | | | The closing arguments have been delivered in the Fair Fight Action v. Raffensperger case, drawing the historic trial to an end. We stand with the people of Georgia as we anticipate a ruling in our case ahead of the upcoming November General Election. The Fair Fight Action v. Raffensperger trial was the longest running federal voting rights trial in the Eleventh Circuit on record. And since day one, our case has always been about giving Georgia voters the opportunity to have their day in court. We’ve done exactly that: presenting testimony from 50 witnesses including voters and would-be voters, legal experts, and current and former state elections officials. During our trial that stretched over two and a half months, we presented substantial documentary evidence to illustrate the burdens Georgia voters face at every stage of the voting process, and how those burdens result from the suppressive practices of the Georgia Secretary of State and the State Election Board. = Let’s be clear: any landscape that makes it harder for people to register, stay registered, and vote does not serve Georgia voters. The Fair Fight Action team will continue fighting to protect the freedom to vote for all Georgians. And we’re committed to continue putting real voters at the center of our conversations to highlight the reality they face. All eligible voters should have their voices heard. Our lawsuit has served as an opportunity to achieve real change on behalf of voters across the state of Georgia who face obstacles trying to exercise their right to vote. And through the evidence brought to light through our trial, it’s clear: voter suppression continues to happen today. But Fair Fight Action and our allies will not stand by. We will continue to fight to protect Georgians’ freedom to vote on every front. = Thank you for everything. Your support during this moment means so much. Rod is a true public servant and is dedicated to serving his country and community. He wants to ensure that every American, through hard work and perseverance, can achieve the American Dream. body:
Grothman attacks Wisconsin Outdoors and Conservation through the repeal of Pittman-Robertson | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/7921d5c904bb/grothman-attacks-wisconsin-outdoors-and-conservation?e=b5f7c20b3f)
---
# Down to the wire, and the campaign is picking up steam.
We are on the final stretch of the campaign, and door knocking is in full swing. We have been to so many places in our district I think Johnny Cash would have to make a 6th District specific song. I truly have appreciated everyone who has taken the time to share their thoughts. Fascinating enough, not one member of the district, even Glenn Grothman fans (however few there are) can answer the same question: What piece of legislation that Grothman has authored are you most proud of? Hint- the answer is none, as Glenn has never actually authored a law.To be clear though, WE DO NOT RUN ATTACK ADS on Glenn Grothman. We only highlight his record.
# Wisconsin Conservation is under attack, by Glenn Grothman and Tom Tiffany.
Wisconsinites love the outdoors. It is part of who we are, whether it is hunting, fishing, hiking, or other activities, we simply cant get enough. Even in the winter we turn to Ice Fishing of all things. Unfortunately Grothman and Tiffany don’t get this.How do we pay for Wisconsin’s conservation efforts? Through what is called the Pittman-Robertson Act. For those unfamiliar, there is a small tax on firearms and other related products. These funds NEVER REACH THE HANDS OF CONGRESS. It is what I call a direct tax, for the money goes straight into a fund that then goes directly into conservation efforts. For reference, $1.5 Billion is raised annually and Wisconsin receives $43.7 Million. It is a wildly successful act since being passed by FDR and is bipartisanly supported. Yes, a bill is supported by both environmentalists and 2nd Amendment enthusiasts. Grothman and Tiffany introduced a law that would repeal Pittman-Robertson, going off on some anti-Biden rant that did not seem to follow any understable logic on society. I say focus the Politics on fiscal policy and other matters and leave conservation out of it. Needless to say, I am a supporter of Pittman-Robertson, and will steadfastly defend the act, or reintroduce it if need be, when in Congress. Oh by the way, the survival of the Bald Eagle is attributed to efforts funded by Pittman-Robertson.It is for reasons such as this Grothman and other out-of-touch politicians need to go. I appreciate everyone’s support during this journey. Of course, if you can see it to contribute to the cause, I am forever grateful.

| | Dear Fellow American, A few years ago, _New York _magazine posed the question: “When Did Everyone Become a Socialist?” This is, of course, an exaggeration. But it makes clear that the far-Left in America aims to bring about a “Great Reset” of our economy and our way of life. In a recent issue of _Imprimis_ —Hillsdale College’s digest of liberty—author Michael Rectenwald described the economic goal of the Great Reset as “‘capitalism with Chinese characteristics’—a two-tiered economy, with profitable monopolies and the state on top and socialism for the majority below.” Today, as a supporter of liberty, you can help Hillsdale College understand the extent of support for—and opposition to—socialism. Your input will help us develop the most effective strategy to fight for the future of liberty in our country. **Will you please share your views on the political, social, and cultural forces promoting socialism in our country by completing your National Survey on Socialism using the secure link below?** **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3e8c6a60b3824eb380e32e6e18a9d11a&_e=oH4ZoQJxLObL1KXzAwdQF9OXmhDrdtmkmNYG-FdH7ljD8Q65lTvTlhpw64jyEg08o6lQgKW96A_k5SYYkmREGak92eGriphiod-PtEHiZ9XKK7VuTpU1j4ru43hgN7QSCOjbtFzX9qYS7c2unvImndnPtV2c-2wUTA0BSTO_-NQ7nlbmMcloDRkUKC7kvU0Uwssf--dLn6ra5uwZtd4dQPXmetvXTB0qxXHPOeL6-gGJk7kMAW3b3IVSfo_EDYMMXZ-xoyvwQ-Tc4le_zL_0WMI0qeu6Roh9ehwynNcMth3I8WXmBryCFSOowT3tZlKFxYQj827POUgHN5axBMa3YgucJZwkZbUqKtYNQuGaJl3KUakcU1wZHHY_HwAw-_SU5veEXDFCuzbusIm14E1eCcnh4Aw2fBWYo0OMnw9aoShWL09tSL1xFh1qh9l9QjGfi09zAqN_tO_rFdD0m4fdcx6Fa1fXfDlsXoNfxQFFAcY%3D)** Sadly, socialism is becoming increasingly popular, especially among the young. You may be aware of a SHOCKING survey showing that... **. . . during the COVID-19 pandemic, support for socialism among those 16 to 23 years old jumped to 49 percent, and socialism also increased in popularity among all ages. ** **Why is this?** Draconian government lockdown measures destroyed businesses and eliminated competitors of corporate monopolists. These policies were a dream come true for corporate socialists. At the same time, too many young Americans have not been taught what socialism really means. Or the dismal history of its failures wherever it has been tried. This is a result of the far-Left’s “long march through the institutions”—including colleges and universities, K-12 schools, and the media. Marxist-inspired critical race theory is a prime example. Once confined to the classrooms of far-Left professors, critical race theory has infiltrated every level of government, as well as school boards and even the military. But it is in our schools where the effects of critical race theory—which teaches young Americans to categorize their fellow citizens according to race—are most dangerous. You may recall that many young Americans with college degrees who championed socialist policies participated in the riots and violence we witnessed in the summer of 2020. In the face of well-financed and widespread efforts to destroy free markets and individual liberty, Hillsdale’s work to **reach** and **teach** millions has never been more urgently needed. **That’s why I need your thoughts quickly. ** By responding to the **National Survey on Socialism **in the next five days**, **your honest opinions will help us understand the recent rise of socialism and develop our strategy to **reach** and **teach** increasing millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. We hope to hear from friends representing every part of the country. Education is the surest way to turn back this dangerous trend. And your partnership with Hillsdale College is critical. As Winston Churchill said, “Socialism is the philosophy of failure, the creed of ignorance, and the gospel of envy.” If you agree, please represent your state and take the **National Survey on Socialism** today. **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/take-the-national-survey-on-socialism/](http://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=3e8c6a60b3824eb380e32e6e18a9d11a&_e=oH4ZoQJxLObL1KXzAwdQF9OXmhDrdtmkmNYG-FdH7ljD8Q65lTvTlhpw64jyEg08o6lQgKW96A_k5SYYkmREGak92eGriphiod-PtEHiZ9XKK7VuTpU1j4ru43hgN7QSCOjbtFzX9qYS7c2unvImndnPtV2c-2wUTA0BSTO_-NQ7nlbmMcloDRkUKC7kvU0Uwssf--dLn6ra5uwZtd4dQPXmetvXTB0qxXHPOeL6-gGJk7kMAW3b3IVSfo_EDYMM9bZeFmt0Ag3MxJ73aVsgeFK0Xzf_ZXL4oEL80yrw2TirCqB8hSm0ROtwrX1D2C5ObO10HLGJcpjukH8Unz0REZsAVuuut2ijJuWM5yrpJ_zyGL2R1nXYcSMNcJK95I1QsRCQg_PF0ZizMagVsL9OofCbHP0kDxytzA6oPzVKJdtamK2ADqJgkj3rpP_qrt0dcFSz4OC6UHOzkJ8ybTGnD_HmSRb1THPWw0VAzD6nDJM%3D)** Despite the recent successes of the far-Left, we must remember—**it is NEVER too late to defend liberty through education**. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844

[1]Justice Democrats

AIPAC, a political organization funded by right-wing foreign policy hawks

ideological bent can see millions spent against them. Recently, AIPAC’s
super PAC spent a whopping $6 million in a single House primary to beat a
former Democratic Congresswoman who had the support of party leadership.

When AIPAC spent $3 million against Justice Democrat Summer Lee, we came
together and eked out a victory in PA-12’s democratic primary. But AIPAC
has defeated some of our candidates and other progressives in primaries
this year.

body:
The media's lens for viewing the government is broken. It's broken in a way that makes it easy for the legacy media to call rea
[View this message in your browser](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zni9a0knbc0lg9q8uj07lae18k6liqa13j92ad2o_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie2pb4clh238h5e8he485he5o75pt7kkpq8ddl69qbcd1jmgr32t5nmepradrmeej3fddnkgp7cc5kmdqjf972u9hfdc5icupn6t1gshqe7dhjegp67d1nmlg66sdgmmpm3cbmmkq62p9meuq6aslkeurt4s3icgr31cj6e9q32tj0s2q6ac70mkom9pj6coored9l61rm8phhmipm8dtgmlin49fg)
| | | [](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2z0hjekoi69fgnlrvbp2ociekusde2175jglourb8_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie2pb4clh2bs)
---
Friend, The media's lens for viewing the government is broken.

It's broken in a way that makes it easy for the legacy media to call real, rational concern hyperbole. It's broken in a way that makes it easy for the media to normalize failure.

When I tell you Joe Biden is a failed president, the media line up to attack me. But make no mistake, he is a failure.

**He has failed the American people.

_He has failed you._**

He, with help from the corporate media, has gone a step further and normalized that failure. It's so normal they look at you sideways for even noticing it.

I need you to pause here for a second. Think about the messages you get on a daily basis from the Biden administration and from their allies in the media. If you boil them down, you'll hear two steady notes. A drum beat:
1. Everything is going fine.

2. Anything that isn't fine isn't Joe Biden's fault.

One. Two. One. Two.

And they're going to keep beating that drum faster and faster and faster to try and misdirect the American people into supporting Biden apologists for office in 2022.

**That's not a tune I will listen to. That's not a tune you're going to hear in Florida.**

Biden's failure isn't something we made up. It's not a set of talking points. The choices he's made are real, their consequences have been devastating, and the pain felt by Americans across the country is real.

This legacy of failure he's cementing is seeping its way into every crevice of our country.

He presided over out-of-control spending that drove up the price of EVERYTHING and inflated away your purchasing power...

He's bowed to climate extremists and embraced an energy policy that you're paying for every day in higher costs at the pump...

Perhaps his greatest failure has been his total negligence regarding our southern border.

**Over 3 million people have illegally crossed the border since he took office. 3,000,000 people. And Joe Biden has done nothing but facilitate it.**

His failure at the border is killing people. It's creating enormous levels of drug trafficking. For the first time ever, the leading cause of death for people 18-45 in the U.S. is fentanyl overdose. 95% of which is coming from the U.S.-Mexico border.

Those deaths are a direct result of Biden's failure. I refuse to ignore that failure. I refuse to accept it. You should not accept it, either.

The 2022 elections are a line in the sand. **In states like Florida, where we have a slate of Biden apologists running for office, _we cannot give one single inch._**

**Not one.**

That's why I wrote to you today. You know Biden has failed. You see it every time you fill up your car. You see it every time you read the news and see crime spilling onto our streets. You hear it every time your kids or grandkids echo some woke nonsense they heard from some Leftist talking points.

But I need you to do more than just know it. I need you to take action. **_[I need you to make a donation right now.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zkg4qt4gtnbak4vvepah7c8p8ffl0a3csmfhnrao_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie2pb4clh2bs "I need you to make a donation right now.")_**

We're going to work for every single vote, every single mind, every single choice. We’re going to ensure that the message that Joe hears on Election Night is crystal-clear:

**Florida isn't Biden Country. America isn't Biden Country.

Failure will not be our legacy.**

**[Please, make a donation right now. Help me deliver that message.](http://e.americanactionnews.com/rd/9z2zfjj3lbiia1oetip2jc07k327c08n1vdiq93q648_rp22sh2s8i66pb0stie2pb4clh2bs)**
Sincerely, __

[](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=899e53caab5149599a9f027a39c72c64&_e=jqpxMQOgbBSZU5lPBAq8oqUqpXzl-Oj1c_cGuLv6jhfQ39SzKL9jOQpLsXnRXFBhToLa7qvGFtPCAf6_iuf4IlaOB6AvHgYy-1pR35E9-xKXaFm6d1K4_lI0POeuioOOJrPY95LchH_WV4iESsRAVH9ffmJ9lfOynotDPutcexZTy4QxGun_7HnKaqLdBg0_0P21Ot4qyMdKcichLphkUxe1CegMtCosrCGaB6OpKEoID27-xq6tD7g_wsaXSQ3UEVr6snxj2axsrPjldnYhcN1eAur9eGYVUSnRDpNcvfvQ4mSDxwSVdqARL79XWVHmMzNx1sbL5MNYzn6czGQTLGUV-cR1eZolNlAOBgrICfOgKueC0u5ViALpuweSj92yreiz6BfOHjIj-t8K9LDKIKWIlaOijAgGQSKqvLoo-93kJren6jPsuyLeWadh7i6V7sLJn4Jp7TAl6KqcRlrHBw%3D%3D)
---
If you don’t know Rep. Zeldin, he’s a staunch advocate for commonsense, conservative policies in Congress – and the Republican nominee for Governor of New York. A man jumped on stage and tried stabbing Rep. Zeldin at a campaign event. Fortunately, the attacker was taken down and Rep. Zeldin was unharmed. **So why should this enrage you?** A lunatic attacks a gubernatorial candidate, gets arrested, charged with a felony, and then...** _IS IMMEDIATELY RELEASED_** ...because of New York’s insane cashless bail policies.
---
[**THIS IS UTTER MADNESS**](https://link.mattjacobsforcongress.com/u/click?_t=efc64eece5bd468cad54456b97abcf7f&_m=899e53caab5149599a9f027a39c72c64&_e=jqpxMQOgbBSZU5lPBAq8oqUqpXzl-Oj1c_cGuLv6jhfQ39SzKL9jOQpLsXnRXFBhToLa7qvGFtPCAf6_iuf4IlaOB6AvHgYy-1pR35E9-xKXaFm6d1K4_lI0POeuioOOJrPY95LchH_WV4iESsRAVH9ffmJ9lfOynotDPutcexZTy4QxGun_7HnKaqLdBg0_0P21Ot4qyMdKcichLphkUxe1CegMtCosrCGaB6OpKEoID27-xq6tD7g_wsaXSQ3U2JA7Ks8e-cB2mqwnPAzHCYlsPOCeUV3L0tvHhgNGa6sUkeDkC_2UW3DtrsrKpDjIAntIHInL3Wvb3ydKOWBxEybyiAW-K_yuDl8QfV_4dO9T4N4V6vWTF-y5QA_8umk-79lpTA0RTCOOwqXuuMnHhapRE1s-43NUu0iFDnEaHPEyno576_kliC_Y7hac03SjE8Lr7bWusjEYKU6cdiiiBw%3D%3D)
---
But wait...if you think New York’s pro-criminal policies are bad, _**California’s are EVEN**_ _**WORSE!**_ That’s because Far-Left California politicians – like my opponent, Rep. Julia Brownley – have spent years demonizing and defunding police, and passing laws that make it incredibly difficult to keep violent criminals off our streets. And they now have their sights on spreading these policies nationwide.
**ENOUGH IS ENOUGH!** As a former Federal Prosecutor, I devoted my career to protecting our community from dangerous criminals. And I'll continue doing so in Congress. That’s why I’ve been overwhelmingly endorsed by law enforcement organizations in California’s 26th District. If you also care deeply about keeping our neighborhoods safe, please consider supporting our campaign by making a donation within your means today.

reproductive rights, student debt cancellation, and the future of the
progressive movement — TONIGHT AT 8:30p ET/5:30 PT!

We’ll also hear from NY State Senate candidate Sarah Blas on her race and
Charly Carter of Democracy Initiative on filibuster reform.

Now is the time to fight.

BERNIE vs MANCHIN

Bernie Sanders [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6147?t=1016&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ]called out Joe Manchin by name on live TV for
“sabotaging the Democratic agenda” again this week – killing a package to
address climate, tax the rich, and cut child poverty and drug prices.

Party leaders would be wise to follow Bernie’s lead, stand up to this
literal coal baron, and actually deliver for folks ahead of November —
when fascism will be on the ballot.

We can’t afford the weakness of Democratic leadership, pretending that
Manchin is negotiating in good faith or representing the people of West
Virginia who actually want and need these critical common sense measures.

[ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=1017&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ]Get active in Our Revolution now to demand action from the party in
power and elect progressives to make Manchin irrelevant!

DEL. SHEILA RUTH LEADS!

Progressive Del. Sheila Ruth is in the lead to be elected to serve her
first full term on the Maryland State Assembly (District 44B)!

Serving on the Environment and Transit Committee, Sheila is working hard
to achieve the positive economic and equity impacts that a well-planned
transportation system would make in the Baltimore region.

Sheila is championing state-based universal healthcare and told us on our
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6089?t=1020&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ]LIVE Broadcast last week how fossil fuel companies must pay for the
climate crisis — “taxpayers shouldn’t be on the hook for that!”

[ http://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4893?t=1021&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ]Sign-up as a sustaining member of Our Revolution to help elect more
candidates like Sheila up and down the ballot!

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6146?t=1022&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ][IMG]

Also in Maryland, ballots are still being counted in a very [ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6148?t=1023&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ]tight race
between incumbent Montgomery County Executive Marc Elrich, and healthcare
CEO David Blair.

Like Sheila Ruth, Elrich is a long-time progressive champion and Our
Revolution Maryland member.

Since his election in 2018, Marc has worked hard to make strides on key
priorities of housing, environment, public education, healthcare, and
economic justice.

“I like doing the work. The most important thing someone can do with their
lives is to be purposeful and make a difference,” Marc told us on our
[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6089?t=1024&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ]National Organizing Call.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/4329?t=1025&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ]SIGN-UP HERE to help Our Revolution get out the vote for other great
progressive candidates ready to partner with our movement for change.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6146?t=1026&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ][IMG]

In Vermont, Our Revolution joins Bernie in backing Peter Welch in his run
for U.S. Senate!

Peter fought housing discrimination in Chicago, was a public defender in
the Upper Valley and has represented Vermont in Congress since 2007.

In the US House, Peter co-sponsored the Green New Deal and is a leader for
lower drug costs, affordable childcare, rural broadband, and protecting
democracy.

Peter is committed to unions, frontline workers, veterans, reproductive
rights, and rebuilding the middle class.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6146?t=1027&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ][IMG]

Becca Balint is also endorsed by both Our Revolution and Bernie Sanders,
and she’s running to represent all of Vermont in Congress!

As a parent and public school teacher, Becca won her seat on the State
Senate in 2014. She became the first openly gay Majority Leader and passed
the first gun safety laws in Vermont history.

Becca also delivered the largest investment in affordable housing in a
generation, and passed the strongest reproductive rights in the nation.

★ ★ ★

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6146?t=1028&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ][IMG]

CLIMATE RALLY w/ JANE FONDA & ANDY LEVIN

We have no time to waste on climate. Our Revolution invites you to rally
with Jane Fonda and US Rep. Andy Levin, one of our best climate champions,
running for re-election in MI-11.

The event kicks off at 4 pm Monday in Royal Oak, MI, and Jane Fonda will
speak alongside OR Michigan leader and DNC Climate Council Michelle
Deatrick and others.

A climate canvass will follow, and Our Revolution volunteers will be on
hand with free T-shirts — let’s knock on every door ahead of Election Day
Aug. 2nd!

While Big Oil and rightwing billionaires fund ads for Andy’s opponent,
we’re reaching voters directly! An original cosponsor of the Green New
Deal, Andy is dedicated to ending the climate crisis through a prosperous
green economy.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/6137?t=1029&akid=3185%2E5885482%2EBvF4I1 ]RALLY WITH JANE & ANDY!

Last week, Andy was arrested two days in a row: on Tuesday as the only man

body:
Hi All,
Alamance County is kicking off door knocking this Saturday, July 30 at 8:30am and they need help! Are you willing to give some of your time? All homes targeted in our door knocking efforts are known registered Republicans. So consider yourself in friendly territory! Courtney will be there as well!

---
| | | Friend,

I’d like to thank you in advance for taking the time to read this and hear me out. I know I’ve been emailing, texting, and calling more than normal right now, but I need to reach my goal by midnight and need you to listen to me.

I hope you know me to be an honest man of integrity, so I thought I’d take a second to walk you through why I’m running for office and why this deadline means so much.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=33ddb1fc7864498d89deca87bbbbdf0b&_e=lFc60rsJqkZp8GR53sv1Aw0KjDKH6vBMWbdiyyoxbvGipuhIFJ3twKYdhnauwUu5ZPCevrB0X9Je-0ounbpaIPJJmzNYDf21kuxtWvXoRVyxcOMA2cVYw_Ow9_xbi8kjX6evReCyoaRWcjhXwfGJg-HQP9mFglPbU6ySNeFZJgdl1rYCsXnIMlkk-m_qe2WyrNXGDeOk4CRJyQqRz259lii0x7rE0El52NsSzEdfH1YrHoTstwrSN_2L8_5KZtor4vP952P4GD0hQjNhnhYjLi8eNR9xghRKWbKJw2HqIRSeYCPNdpjwHb1n59FISkn5jyx57Sk_peaYUaeMpZTgycGCt4zNH-jqrxxKw5xVcabSPriT_0Sukfq9CXclHuJEjamAETMfwIEv0wOcK9jw3l6kUlkGKb1fKkn4xMh8E6125_0X2oO_MTBASWCdl0AR "2")
---

This is a photo of my dad (of course wearing a Miami Dolphins shirt). He was the best role model for being a father, a friend, and an American.

He and my mom thankfully came to America before the murderous dictator Fidel Castro came to power and turned Cuba to a dangerous socialist wasteland. After my parents saw what he had done to their homeland, they decided to stay put in America and get to work to achieve the American Dream.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=33ddb1fc7864498d89deca87bbbbdf0b&_e=lFc60rsJqkZp8GR53sv1Aw0KjDKH6vBMWbdiyyoxbvGipuhIFJ3twKYdhnauwUu5ZPCevrB0X9Je-0ounbpaIPJJmzNYDf21kuxtWvXoRVyxcOMA2cVYw_Ow9_xbi8kjX6evReCyoaRWcjhXwfGJg-HQP9mFglPbU6ySNeFZJgdl1rYCsXnIMlkk-m_qe2WyrNXGDeOk4CRJyQqRz259lii0x7rE0El52NsSzEdfH1a5U66cE58GyGh9fNCbSAUnRvjIQHeBye-96VAibbjqfq0IJpuD1xgyqwci51zzqMdUZPtUifDQgtw4X_4g9qTHzCYXgX_rOkPc4yEB_mtqxukYG6S-FShKZPibNchUanWhY16HPxGzm4WDNZRoOujWnrgcS4lciGYOdw4Lp6Z3d3CgmuiSZVcF4YhLl5P_2URbhGGdw2MvOhJU3hM-lld4 "1")
---

Eventually, my sister and I became first generation college graduates, and while we had to take on student loans to do so, we knew the work ethic our parents instilled would help us pay them down once we graduated.

I met my wife Jeanette through mutual friends and we got married in 1998. We started our beautiful family of four kids: Amanda, Daniella, Anthony, and Dominick. We eventually adopted two dogs, Winston and Arthur (who I found with my laptop typing some emails to you recently...).

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=33ddb1fc7864498d89deca87bbbbdf0b&_e=lFc60rsJqkZp8GR53sv1Aw0KjDKH6vBMWbdiyyoxbvGipuhIFJ3twKYdhnauwUu5ZPCevrB0X9Je-0ounbpaIPJJmzNYDf21kuxtWvXoRVyxcOMA2cVYw_Ow9_xbi8kjX6evReCyoaRWcjhXwfGJg-HQP9mFglPbU6ySNeFZJgdl1rYCsXnIMlkk-m_qe2WyrNXGDeOk4CRJyQqRz259lii0x7rE0El52NsSzEdfH1bmJl-cKalqoR1jicBM5nTzvg-cwfOInh4W4kL7ynM4mv3_tOGW6-ehT3ny_4EWu5O96AaAYH5EDb8qY1a2lpEl71QqqHQSHduYTZH7yc9RKQFZUbuLpKMcKOoNpwIr8pSM94gvuwb2qFDi6bfaXRfK5q8AvaDrVq135KeewzZDLLt301zQKfxvR_XiX-xGIbJhpbb2QzFa7t9mIoIueEZp "3")
---

All jokes aside, being a father to my wonderful kids is by far my favorite and most important job, and I will never take that for granted.

I first ran for Senate because I saw what Barack Obama and Joe Biden’s policies were doing to families like mine. More families were living paycheck to paycheck at the expense of tax-and-spend Democrats. My parents taught me to work if I wanted to make a change, so that’s exactly what I did.

My dad never got to see me become a U.S. Senator in the country he immigrated to in order to make a better life for us, but I carry his work ethic and family values with me every day in the Senate to honor him, and now, I’m teaching my kids exactly what he taught me.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=33ddb1fc7864498d89deca87bbbbdf0b&_e=lFc60rsJqkZp8GR53sv1Aw0KjDKH6vBMWbdiyyoxbvGipuhIFJ3twKYdhnauwUu5ZPCevrB0X9Je-0ounbpaIPJJmzNYDf21kuxtWvXoRVyxcOMA2cVYw_Ow9_xbi8kjX6evReCyoaRWcjhXwfGJg-HQP9mFglPbU6ySNeFZJgdl1rYCsXnIMlkk-m_qe2WyrNXGDeOk4CRJyQqRz259lii0x7rE0El52NsSzEdfH1aOGLFLwYfJ-znYXJXLVh2FkWWrDOdmjQr3Z1wskXlijAn9TAD-5NU3fJhgzAir8qADZKY3dCGdLmfXViUYecwRJZi_TenKyiPq-wkOIPgBX5Hyxp9gzopZhMYiZMC9imH-IFMznMoqhdwRmaPbx2whGbd5O8O3MzoigDEDQHAmdzJ8Ieo-tKnmYQSfs6OL1-42LC371UV6SERE4UA6zJBM "4")
---

After seeing the dysfunction in Washington firsthand, I decided to run for President so I could bring my passion for America to the White House. My loving family was right by my side, and I couldn’t have been more grateful for their support.

I wanted to stop Hillary Clinton at all costs, and eventually, that meant dropping out of the race and working with Donald Trump to win. Throughout his term, we worked on pro-family and pro-veteran bills to make America great and restore the American Dream.

---
| [](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=33ddb1fc7864498d89deca87bbbbdf0b&_e=lFc60rsJqkZp8GR53sv1Aw0KjDKH6vBMWbdiyyoxbvGipuhIFJ3twKYdhnauwUu5ZPCevrB0X9Je-0ounbpaIPJJmzNYDf21kuxtWvXoRVyxcOMA2cVYw_Ow9_xbi8kjX6evReCyoaRWcjhXwfGJg-HQP9mFglPbU6ySNeFZJgdl1rYCsXnIMlkk-m_qe2WyrNXGDeOk4CRJyQqRz259lii0x7rE0El52NsSzEdfH1YNfOy-WqDl44m9gn_h7ru1Mg0H21I_zW9fPzl9YHfzcJMSYbK0aj29ZxNHG-hnCeb6IIjJWZCPlJxeUf7EQs9a2-HevG47afCHP0qzBYB8D_FtHkexhp-j4_SjLX5k7FjTgP1ml6UfjkGmXFdt6J0disXo6fNUisDpl9lt701ihtvP__e_gugI9ujrxqf1gOWRxGePrEEwNpM3b8s0IQUM "5")
---

This brings me to my main point: I’m running for Senate because I will never stop fighting to restore the American Dream.

I feel so blessed looking through these photos, and I wanted to share them with you so you can understand where I am coming from.

Reaching these deadlines may seem like a fundraising ploy, but this is real. **If we’re outraised again, that will be a major step back in our fight to restore the American Dream.**
**[I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:](http://links.conservativelibertywire.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=33ddb1fc7864498d89deca87bbbbdf0b&_e=lFc60rsJqkZp8GR53sv1Aw0KjDKH6vBMWbdiyyoxbvGipuhIFJ3twKYdhnauwUu5ZPCevrB0X9Je-0ounbpaIPJJmzNYDf21kuxtWvXoRVyxcOMA2cVYw_Ow9_xbi8kjX6evReCyoaRWcjhXwfGJg-HQP9mFglPbU6ySNeFZJgdl1rYCsXnIMlkk-m_qe2WyrNXGDeOk4CRJyQqRz259lii0x7rE0El52NsSzEdfH1a1CWGMWICQ9yS2QfUbqbEqhl66atufmtG_zH8HIlIAfdx4W0mnRvArQSl2qlus9PNBFVF082FzDt9vhcrWz0oYCzGG9121t_cB4oDxBHi4BnD1lQJd2aLbU46MRP7r9zRDBhmCVXck924apOXv5J8BhhBjFhYUoNrZUVpTH9PGYZW_HB1N2TYKTJUtFCxWUrcAlUon9jRPkmB8hg3vHeul "I hope you’ll make a donation today and join this fight before my deadline:")**
---

Marco Rubio

body:
Here’s what comes up:
#
Hi Derek!
Andrea Ramunno here, National Finance Director for John’s campaign.
So, I just wanted to remind you. We have less than four months until Pennsylvania’s U.S. Senate General Election.
My team and I want to share a quick update on how the numbers are looking.
Right now, to keep up the pace with the spending from Dr. Oz + his super PACs, it looks like we’re going to need to raise at least $1 million in the next six days to keep up the pace.
**Now, we know it is a lot of $$$, but we need all the support we can get if we want to fund our outreach plans.**
[**_Can you help us kickoff our goal by making a contribution today? Any amount will help us reach our goal by July 31._**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220725-1?refcode=em20220725-6636&refcode2=6636_434096_aBiUj9&akid=6636%2E434096%2EaBiUj9)
**[Donate Now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jf-email-20220725-1?refcode=em20220725-6636&refcode2=6636_434096_aBiUj9&akid=6636%2E434096%2EaBiUj9)**
__
We’re hitting the ground running now that Election Day is on the horizon — we’re expanding our 67-county organizing work, recruiting hundreds more volunteers, and making sure not a single voter falls through the cracks this November.
No matter how big this campaign gets, John won’t take a penny from corporate PACs or shady special interests. We wouldn’t have it any other way.
But that also means we’re relying completely on online supporters like you to help us meet our goal before our first monthly fundraising deadline in the general election.
**It’s tough (and expensive) to run a unique, grassroots-funded campaign that’s unlike any others. And that’s why we’re reaching out to you, Derek.[_Can you make a donation today to help us reach our $1 million goal? Thank you!
Andrea

_**"I will land it for the people of Minnesota's 6th."****Jeanne**_
---
Hi Peter, Thank you so much for your continued support. I wanted to send you an email about the good news of our campaign and my priorities for the people of Minnesota's 6th. We hosted 14 interns this summer. An amazing group of young dedicated individuals who have helped us in so many areas of our campaign from issue policy research work to campaign awareness projects. I have been on the frontlines fighting for and defending our Democracy by speaking with and hearing the concerns of the people. Here are my priorities for the people of Minnesota's 6th:
* Defend our Democracy and protect the right to vote.
* Strongly support Minnesota’s farmers and working families.
* Provide quality health care for all and lower prescription drug prices for our Senior Citizens and Minnesotan families.
* Honor our Veterans. Increase funding to the Veterans Administration and provide our military veterans with mental health care when needed.
* Protect women’s rights and women’s health care decisions.
* Address climate change to further reduce carbon emissions to protect our environment.
* The Bipartisan Safer Communities Act was a good start and we need to pass more common-sense gun safety legislation now that will protect our families and children.
* Strongly support our local law enforcement officers and fully fund police reform to end systemic inequities in our society.

When elected, I will land it for the people of Minnesota's 6th! [Your continued support for my campaign is greatly appreciated. Our end-of-month fundraising deadline is six days away. Will you donate at least $1 or another amount today to help us meet our July fundraising goals?](http://clicksp.hendricks2022.com/f/a/UUP63YbL488n-yYWWLJIbQ~~/AAPPAAA~)

# We Are On the Ballot, We Need Your Vote
---
| **A Victory For Rebekah Jones and District 1 Voters** Last week Judge John Cooper of the Florida 2nd Judicial Circuit struck down the emergency injunction to have Rebekah Jones removed from the August 23rd Democratic Primary ballot. To Judge Cooper's credit, he refused to allow legal maneuvers to disenfranchise the voters of Florida District 1. This is not only a victory for Jones, but also for the thousands of voters who have already voted for her as their Democrat Nominee to defeat Matt Gaetz in the upcoming general election. “This is about election integrity. Every vote must count, and we are seeing to that” was Jones response. With this victory today, we look forward to a proper hearing on August 5, where we will continue to fight and win for the citizens of Northwest Florida. We do, however, think it sad that our opponents are so afraid to talk about solutions for the real challenges we are facing - maintaining and expanding our military presence in the Panhandle; fighting for a VA hospital within the District while gaining more of the benefits our veterans were promised; strong accountability and oversight over local utility companies, solutions for affordable housing and many more everyday issues we face as taxpaying citizens. What we do not need are political opponents creating false scenarios to remove a candidate from the ballot, who have nothing to offer the voters and are only desperate to win the only way they know they can. In America, this should not stand. Finally, I look forward to continuing my communication with the community, to continue enhancing and making Florida Congressional District 1 the best place to live in the nation.

Hello,
My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day.
My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close.
Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why.
You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office.
**After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks.**
The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you.
**There’s less than 4 hours until our next critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $65,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. So I have to ask:**
[**Please, may I count on you to make a donation to my campaign today – before our fundraising deadline? clean_body: If you believe you received this message in error or wish to no longer receive email from us, please. Hello, My mother worked alongside my dad in Lebanon Farm Shop well into their 70s. They refused assistance from their many children even after they lost their life savings in the Savings and Loan debacle of the 1980s. My mom in coveralls, petite as she was, handing tools to my dad is an indelible image I carry with me to this day. My dad built a business repairing farm implements. In a way, I think he hoped that I’d stick around and take it over, but that wasn’t to be. I joined the Navy after getting a scholarship and my life as a machinist and welder came to a close. Dad said very little about his service in the Second World War. He had the burns and shrapnel of his first ship sinking, and would provide some quips about surviving a night amongst the flotsam and death off Guadalcanal, but he didn’t dissuade me from enlisting. My mom had the bravery in saying quite simply, “The healthy bird flees the nest.” She wiped her eyes on her apron as I drove up the hill on my way to ‘boot camp.’ It took me some time to understand why. You could say my mom and dad embodied rural Iowa values in their unique ways: Family, hard work, sacrifice, education, and honesty. And I think of them every day on the campaign trail, because it’s those values that drove me to run for political office. After nearly 4 decades serving in the United States Navy, I’m running for Senate against Chuck Grassley because it’s time politicians in Washington fight for everyday people like my folks. The early polls all show this will be a close race, so of course, I’m facing down millions of dollars in Super PAC attacks. I don’t come from some political dynasty, and I’m not taking corporate PAC money. Instead, I’m relying entirely on the donations of generous grassroots donors like you. There’s less than 4 hours until our next critical fundraising deadline, and right now we’re still short of our $65,000 goal and what we need to defeat Chuck Grassley and win. ---
| | | **Rep. Marilyn Strickland Votes With Nancy Pelosi Yet Again, Sends American Oil Reserves to China While Her Own District Suffers**
Puyallup, WA—Police Captain and U.S. Army veteran Keith Swank slammed yet another vote by Marilyn Strickland siding with Nancy Pelosi and China over her own district. The vote that would have banned oil from the U.S. Strategic Oil Reserves from being sent to China was defeated as Strickland joined a unified vote with other democrats and Speaker Pelosi.

“Rep. Strickland’s vote to continue the Biden administration’s policy of sending American Oil Reserves to China is a betrayal of our district and the entire country,” said Swank.

“Gas here in the district is still averaging five dollars a gallon. It’s clear her interests aren’t the same as her own voters.

“There’s a lot of big unanswered questions about Strickland’s activities associated with China,” Swank continued.

“Her long record of putting the Chinese government before the people she represents stretches back to her time as Mayor of Tacoma, when she advocated for foreign interests and appeared in a Chinese government-controlled state propaganda publication called China Daily.

“Rep. Strickland’s ostentatious courting of Xi Jinping and the Chinese Communist Party on several trips to China and a high-profile visit to her husband’s workplace in Tacoma should raise some red flags.

“Much to the anger of many democrat voters in Tacoma, Strickland was also involved in talks of a Methanal and LNG plant being placed in the port to serve Chinese customers. Conveniently, this was during the same time period Hunter Biden was involved in similar projects.

“Strickland’s streak of 100% percent allegiance in voting with Pelosi and Biden’s agenda isn’t boding well for her claim of ‘working across the aisle’ which is nothing more than a ruse.

“In addition to economic problems, crime around here is out-of-control due to bad democrat leadership from the top down. As a cop sworn to protect and defend our citizens, I’ll always put innocent victims before criminals. When the GOP takes back congress next year, I’ll back policies to lift the country up and put the bad guys back in jail – where they belong.

He served as Night Duty Commander and Commander of the Metro Special Response Section (S.W.A.T. Team, Harbor Patrol, Canine Unit and Arson/Bomb Squad). We started out struggling. My dad was a union grocery worker at ShopRite, working night shifts. The union way of life helped keep our family together while he went to college. Dad ended up graduating, and got a good job as an underwriter.

After we moved, I grew up in suburban south central Pennsylvania. I graduated from Central York High School and went to college in Reading, just like my dad did.

When I left Pennsylvania for grad school, I *never* envisioned myself ending up in public service — not as Mayor of Braddock for 15 years, and certainly not as Lieutenant Governor of Pennsylvania.

But I came back to Pennsylvania because that's where my heart is. **And alongside my amazing wife, Gisele, I have dedicated my life to improving our Commonwealth.**

When Pennsylvania lawmakers pushed outdated, discriminatory policies banning marriage equality, I officiated one of the first gay marriages in Pennsylvania.** 🌈**

When Braddock was overlooked and counted out, we created jobs and got young people engaged. We created a community center, urban gardens, and a free store run by Gisele. **✊**

Hello,
We are just a few weeks away from our primary election, and we’re looking to make one last push on the organizing front to reach out to as many voters as possible.
Vermonters and Americans from all across the country have already come together under a shared vision for our nation—a vision only achievable if we protect and expand our Democratic majority in the Senate.
While the work is worthwhile, it also requires a significant amount of resources. And unlike other candidates for higher office, we’re powered by small-dollar donations adding up, not the deep-pocketed megadonors and shady corporate interests. We’ve got more work to do between now and the primary—and into the fall—but we’ll need the full strength of this grassroots movement to make the most impact possible.
[**Your contribution helps us reach more voters and gets us one step closer to the Senate. Make a donation of $5 or more right away to support our organizing efforts down the stretch.**](https://act.welchforvermont.com/go/3521?t=3&akid=713%2E61531%2E_jLDo6)

Our organizing efforts are the key to our success these midterms, and none of it is possible without folks on our team who care—folks just like you.
