Typically, it's alongside a dishonest legacy media headline misrepresenting my agenda, insulting the people of Florida, or implying FREEDOM is the latest and greatest threat to America. It is an insulting and absurd way to distort the truth and mislead you, the American public. Their attempts at intimidation won't work on me though. I am not backing down. Not even a little bit. I welcome the "insults" and the hard work to refute them because I know the importance of strong leadership in a time like this. That is why I'm running for re-election, and I hope you'll If you're still hesitant about getting involved, I'd like to remind you what we're up against. It is evident how far to the left the media has gone by looking at how they define "radical." Allowing grown men and women to assess personal risk and decide to wear a mask or not: RADICAL. Allowing CHILDREN under 9 years old to make life-altering, sometimes irreversible, decisions about their "gender identity": JUST FINE! Encouraging an educational environment focused on learning and preparing students for the real world: RADICAL. Encouraging students to hate themselves, their peers, and our country: JUST FINE! The stakes could not be higher. These out-of-touch liberal elites are so threatened by rational thought that they will call me radical for standing with everyday people on the side of common sense and sanity. If that makes me a radical, so be it. I will always defend our liberty, protect our children, and promote the ideals of our Constitution which make our country the greatest on earth. No amount of intimidation or petty name-calling is going to change that. From my time in the Navy to my time in Congress, I have always been committed to preserving our freedom and building a better future for our children. I have three children, and I worry every day about the consequences that progressive policies could have on their lives. We have open borders inviting millions of illegal aliens, potential criminals, and thousands of pounds of illegal drugs into our country. At the same time, liberals try to defund our police forces and appoint judges who are soft on crime. We're experiencing record-high inflation which threatens families with higher costs at the pump and the grocery store, all while the Biden administration spends your tax dollars into oblivion. We have kids - who are just trying to get an education - being injected by the anti-American agenda of woke corporations, woke politicians, and fraudulent media elites who have lost their grip on reality. I will never let these out-of-touch fanatical liberals win. As a federal prosecutor, I dedicated my time to convicting child predators and removing dangerous criminals from our Florida streets. I continued my mission in Congress by authoring bills that ended the secret taxpayer-billed slush funds members of Congress were using to pay off those who accused them of sexual harassment. Our law enforcement, prosecutors, judges, and elected officials should work to protect us - not to protect criminals. Now, as Governor, I am standing by our law enforcement officers and holding the Soros-funded, soft-on-crime prosecutors accountable to keep our communities and our families safe. I took immediate action to end the COVID theater which crippled our nation and focused on empowering small businesses with common-sense tax policies which made it easy to hire American and fuel our Florida economy. Florida is in a better place now than it was before the pandemic - and that 's not something liberal governors can say today. I'm also leading the fight for parents and students against the poisonous, WOKE elitists to ensure our education system is NOT an indoctrination camp. It's simple: we 're not going to tell kindergarteners they are racist or they are oppressed. And we're not going to force-feed our children progressive ideologies that are confusing and wildly inappropriate for their age. We will prepare the next generation for greatness by teaching real history instead of perverting our past to serve the ideological goals of far-left activists who would like our children to hate America and each other. Every student should feel empowered to succeed - and together, we can make sure that they do. If all this is "RADICAL," then Peter, I think you and I have something in common: we're both RADICAL. I could use your help continuing what we started here in Florida. Will you chip in now to become an official supporter of my campaign? Make no mistake: this race won't be easy. We know liberals will do anything to win when they're afraid of the opposition. And they're VERY afraid of me. They've already proven they'll try anything to keep me out of the Governor's mansion. Since I became Governor, we have made big moves to ensure Florida's election laws are free and fair. We made it HARDER TO CHEAT by banning ballot harvesting, strengthening voter ID, and prohibiting "Zuckerbucks." I have no doubt they'll try harder to make sure we don't outsmart and outfight them in 2022. That's why I need the support of patriots like you, to make sure we're prepared to win whatever battles we face next. Peter, I've seen what we can accomplish in just a short period of time. I've watched us win and lay the foundation for future successes. But I also know that this is just the beginning. That's why I am asking you for your help now. It's time for patriots like you and me to come together and ensure this "radical" freedom we're fighting for continues for another four years. In an election year like this one, we cannot afford to give one inch. We cannot lose Florida to the woke progressives who would destroy everything we've worked so hard for. Are you with me? body:

| | | | |
---
| | |

| |

| | | | | Peter, I don’t know why Republicans field so many unqualified, ridiculous, and sometimes scary people to run for office. But as long as they keep doing it, I’ll keep telling you about it so we can work together to stop them. And this guy, **this** guy ... **Doug Mastriano is dangerous to our families and the very fabric of our country** Right wing lunatic, Doug Mastriano, is a raging conspiracy-peddler, a seditionist traitor who was in Washington on January 6th trying to overthrow Joe Biden's very large and legal election to the presidency, and it has now come out he's a **raging anti-semite**. **[Will you _please_ join me in giving $2, $5, $10 or whatever you can afford to Josh Shapiro, so we can ensure he's the next Governor of Pennsylvania?](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb91eafd6-a716-41b8-9cb0-dbe2d404cf7c/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** **If you haven't heard of the social media platform Gab, you're lucky. It is the choice of Neo-Nazis in America and worldwide. Its founder, Andrew Torba, isn't the slightest bit shy about his anti-Semitism. Just a few days ago, Torba put up a post blaming Jews for "white genocide," has called Jews "subversive," highlighted Gab posters sharing classic anti-Semitic propaganda about Jews controlling government, the media, finance, and being "Christ killers." Torba even praised Gab users offering "differing perspectives on The Holocaust."** _So you'd think Mastriano, when he found this out, rebuked him or stopped posting on Gab, right? Nope._ **_Mastriano hired Torba as a political consultant. Here is the filth Mastriano's consultant has given us._**_From the ADL:_ _Gab, a self-described “free speech” platform, has a long history as a haven for antisemites, extremists and conspiracy theorists._Robert Bowers, the white supremacist who murdered 11 people at a Pittsburgh synagogue in 2018, made numerous _[antisemitic posts](https://default.salsalabs.org/T8e25c92b-f0de-496b-9711-59064337c24d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) _ on his Gab account in the weeks prior to the shooting._ Three years later, antisemitic content persists on the platform, easily accessible within just a few clicks. Well-known antisemites like [David Duke](https://default.salsalabs.org/Ta4035c8e-de44-4f50-91b8-2b346f46f53b/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9), [Rick Wiles](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6f79b76e-95bf-4faf-b081-ecf75490133a/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) and [Nicholas Fuentes](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tb67cca5a-6ae7-4713-9811-eb07de9b2311/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) maintain an active presence on the site._ Running against this threat to Pennsylvania and our republic, is Josh Shapiro, a longtime public servant who has been an incredible Attorney General of Pennsylvania and is now running for Governor. **Shapiro is Jewish, so it's quite obvious the open anti-Semitism is part of Doug Mastriano's sick strategy** , to try and incite, anger and win the votes of every last person he can lead on the path towards hatred in Pennsylvania. If this leads to another Tree of Life type massacre, he couldn't care less.

* Allowing CHILDREN under 9 years old to make life-altering, sometimes irreversible, decisions about their "gender identity": _**JUST FINE!**_

body:
[1]Charles Booker

Peter, when I look
back on the progress we’ve made, I’m overwhelmed with gratitude.

From becoming the first Black candidate in Kentucky to win the Democratic
primary, to receiving endorsements from iconic progressive leaders like
Bernie Sanders – our campaign is gaining serious momentum. 🔥

We built this campaign from the ground up. When we started, we didn’t have
a million dollars in the bank to fall back on or support from the
political establishment.

But we did have a story. So many of you graciously listened to the story
of my family. I grew up in one of the poorest ZIP codes in Kentucky. Both
of my parents had to drop out of high school to help take care of my
brothers and sisters. We sometimes had to go without heat in the winter or
air conditioning in the summer. My mom often went without eating so that I
could.

Seeing how my story resonated with so many of you was a powerful reminder
that my story isn’t unique at all. Millions of families are still
struggling to reach the same goals and aspirations of my family.

That’s why I’m running to take on Rand Paul and give our families the
representation they deserve in the Senate.

Charles

| | | |

I am pleased to announce I will be holding a series of townhall meetings throughout the district that are open to the public. These meetings will allow citizens to meet with me and discuss issues of concern and ask questions about my approach to addressing these issues.

subject: Team Gibbs - Upcoming Events!
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY JOHN GIBBS FOR CONGRESS, INC_
body:
Volunteers needed! | | | |
---
| | | Dear Peter,

Primary Election Day is almost here, and we only have 8 days left as we sprint towards the finish line. Our team is grateful for all of the support that you have given us. We would not be here, on the precipice of this historic victory, without each and every one of you.

As I am sure you can imagine, there are lots of things going on over these next several days. We do not expect everyone off you to be able to help with everything listed below, but if all of you help in one area, we will **_Defeat Pete_** and prove that he can not use his families wealth to buy this seat again. Let's show him and globalists all over the world that the good people of West-Michigan are too smart, too well informed, and too discerning for their lies to work, regardless of how much outside money is pumped in.

See you on the campaign trail!

Sincerely,

Team Gibbs

P.S. We are always looking for more place to tour around the district. Please email us at team@votejohngibbs.com if you are connected to a manufacturing, agriculture, or other business that would be willing to show us around.
---
|
---
| **_Upcoming Volunteer Opportunities_**
**Thursday, July 28th | Muskegon Phone Bank | 4:00pm **
Please bring your laptop and come help us call voters at Barclay Place Event Center! This is critical to ensure they remember to vote and have heard about John. We will be making phone calls from 4:00pm - 5:30pm and then enjoying some pizza while we get ready for the Town Hall at 6:30pm. Please email dcool@votejohngibbs.com to RSVP.

**Saturday, July 30th | Byron Days Parade**
Team Gibbs will be walking in the Byron Days Parade! RSVP at [team@votejohngibbs.com](mailto:team@votejohngibbs.com?subject=RSVP%20-%20Byron%20Days%20Parade) and you will receive parade details. Come walk with us!

**Saturday, July 30th | Door Knocking | 12:00pm - 4:00PM**
Please RSVP to dcool@votejohngibbs.com if your would like to help us Get Out The Vote and knock on some doors for John. Please include the city/county that you would prefer to work in and we will try to partner you up with a Team Leader in that area.

**Saturday, July 30th | Turning Point Action | Door Launch | 10:00am**
Turning Point USA has endorsed John Gibbs and they will host a Door Launch Rally in Walker. Please _[Click Here](https://votejohngibbs.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=125d68a9918858e87dbc3c37d&id=117b56ed90&e=c238e8971e)_ if you would like to attend the rally and knock on doors with them.

**Muskegon County Fair | July 25th - 30th**
We would love for some of our volunteers to help staff the booth at the Muskegon County Fair. You are allowed to wear your John Gibbs gear! To sign up or acquire more information, send an email to: [muskegoncountyrepublicans@gmail.com](mailto:muskegoncountyrepublicans@gmail.com?subject=Muskegon%20County%20Fair).

**_Upcoming Events_**
**Thursday, July 28th | John Gibbs for Congress Town Hall**
Join us for our town hall hosted by the Muskegon GOP at Barclay Place Event Center from 6:30-8:00pm! RSVP [here](https://votejohngibbs.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=125d68a9918858e87dbc3c37d&id=5497bd67f2&e=c238e8971e).

**Tuesday August 2nd | John Gibbs Election Watch Party | 8:00pm**
We will be sending out an email with the details of our Election Night Watch Party. Please keep an eye out for it. We would love to celebrate our victory with you.
---
| | |
---
| Want to change how you receive these emails?
You can [update your preferences](https://votejohngibbs.us14.list-manage.com/profile?u=125d68a9918858e87dbc3c37d&id=1362c589c6&e=c238e8971e&c=a68fc117db) or [unsubscribe from this list](https://votejohngibbs.us14.list-manage.com/unsubscribe?u=125d68a9918858e87dbc3c37d&id=1362c589c6&e=c238e8971e&c=a68fc117db).

body:
Elissa Slotkin for Congresssecure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220725&amount=28 [secure.actblue.com/donate/slotkinq32022?refcode=email20220725&amount=28]
Team,
Sometimes, funny things happen on the campaign trail.
Here’s one of those funny moments from the 4th of July. I had just finished walking in a parade in Mason when I ran into Jake Hagg – he’s the man who is running a write-in primary campaign against my likely opponent.
We had never met before, but when we recognized each other he shouted “You and I agree on almost nothing, except that Tom Barrett should have voted for those 5,000 auto jobs!!”
Indeed.
My opponent has voted six times against bipartisan initiatives in the Michigan State Senate that will bring thousands of good-paying auto jobs to Michigan, including 5,000 jobs at a brand-new EV battery plant in the district he hopes to represent and at other General Motors plants in our area. These initiatives had wide, bipartisan support. As my interaction with Mr. Hagg illustrates, it’s a choice that continues to baffle people on both sides of the aisle.
To me, this is simple: we can either build the next generation of cars or we can watch our jobs and our economic futures be shipped down South or overseas. I want to build those cars right here in Michigan – and I want to provide the best auto workers in the world to do it.
If you care about people over ideology – these votes should have been a no brainer. Even my opponent’s opponent knows that!

body:
Peggy Schiller is an experienced, qualified Democrat. Her opponent will likely be disqualified. Make sure your vote counts. | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/58ee06e6336d/vote-for-an-experienced-qualified-democrat-on-823?e=9c22e4067b)
---
| |
---
| | Hello Peter,

**On August 5th, a final hearing will be held to determine if my opponent, Rebekah Jones, will be disqualified from the ballot. **

**Documentation showing that Jones did not comply with regulations to qualify for public office** based on her voter registration history have been verified by the Montgomery County Maryland Board of Elections.

These records show **Jones was registered as an Independent from June 11 - August 11, 2021**, causing her to be about 60 days shy of the 365-days registered as a Democrat that is required for candidacy. The full story and documentation can be viewed on [my Blog](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=c846174433&e=9c22e4067b).
---
| [Read Full Story >](https://outlook.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5bfd640916a1b05d7592a2dd1&id=f6018caf59&e=9c22e4067b "Read Full Story >")
---
| **Why Did I File a Lawsuit?**

**All candidates must comply with both federal and state regulations in order to qualify for public office -- without exception.**

We filed suit because**it is in the best interest of both the Democratic Party and the constituents of the First Congressional District to ensure there is a qualified Democratic candidate available to unseat Matt Gaetz in the general election**.

If we had not filed this suit when we did, we can be sure the Republicans would have, if Jones were to win the primary. Thus, **ignoring this issue _now_ would potentially leave the Democratic party without an eligible candidate on the ballot in November**, ceding the election to the Republican party unchallenged.
---
| **I Will Honor My Oath.**

As candidates, we take an oath and we give our word. **I promise to honor my oath and to fight for the people of this district to improve their lives in meaningful ways.**

**All candidates should be held accountable and – _at a minimum_ – should meet the qualifications for candidacy before taking on the enormous responsibility of holding public office.**
---
| **How Can You Help?**

After first pursuing other options before filing suit, we quickly realized the administrative procedure for the State of Florida takes far too long and would not be completed before the primary. Uncovering the truth requires additional resources from the campaign that we did not anticipate.

**Any help that you can give in the form of a donation would be greatly appreciated. **
